records.name: RepoRoad
records.tagline: The endless lo-fi drive where every repo is a building
records.description: GitHub is where people pour years of their life — and it all arrives as a row in a list. RepoRoad gives some life to that list. Every repository is a building on one shared road: same road, same time, same lo-fi track for everyone on it. Stars set the height, a floor per 10,000. Explore projects, chat with visitors, send chickens across the road. Add your repo and design its building. Less leaderboard, more neighbourhood — would love to see your repo out there.

records.name: Edgee Codex Compressor V2
records.tagline: Use Codex at 35.6% lower costs
records.description: We benchmarked Codex alone against Codex routed through Edgee's compression gateway on the same repo, with the same model, under the same workflow. The result: Codex + Edgee used 49.5% fewer input tokens, improved cache hit rate from 76.1% to 85.4%, and reduced total session cost by 35.6%. This post breaks down why context compression makes Codex more efficient, more frugal, and materially cheaper to run without sacrificing useful output.

records.name: MeshEdit
records.tagline: Model, rig and animate game assets in your browser
records.description: Create low-poly game assets in your browser. Model, rig and animate, then export optimized GLB. Built with GPT-6 Astra, with WebMCP tools so agents can create and refine editable assets alongside you. Free to use.

records.name: Stile.iD
records.tagline: A private identity verification API to verify real users
records.description: Know the real person behind high-risk actions in your app. Stile’s API helps you reduce fraud when users onboard, recover accounts, change payout details, or transact in your marketplace. Add ID checks, liveness, and face matching in minutes. Get a signed verification result without storing users’ ID documents yourself. Raw ID images are deleted after verification by default. Self-service, usage-based pricing. Get Proof with Privacy.

records.name: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace
records.tagline: From Chinese AI evidence to implementation with Astra
records.description: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace shows brands how they appear across Chinese AI discovery journeys, then turns evidence-backed gaps into implementation-ready action. GEO Actions uses GPT-6 Astra to create channel-specific assets from verified brand facts, check material claims against those facts, route them through human approval, and record the exact version implemented.

records.name: MiRemoteBridge
records.tagline: a $5 build that lets a Bluetooth remote run your PC
records.description: Turn almost any Bluetooth remote into a driverless keyboard and media controller for your PC with a $5 ESP32-C3. No apps, drivers, admin rights, or system modifications. Flash, configure Wi-Fi, and remap every key directly from the browser. Supports Xiaomi RC003 and standard BLE remotes, with live key feedback and fully local processing.

records.name: Unvendor
records.tagline: A shared UI between you and the AI
records.description: Unvendor turns your wishes into an interactive canvas. No more chatting: plan a trip, adjust a budget, practise a language through tools you can use and change. We push the conversation to the background and the interface to the foreground. Follow-ups update the canvas as your plans evolve. Keep your main activity in view, open more tools alongside it, and return to saved canvases. New and different way to interact with AI.

records.name: illusions
records.tagline: A Japanese-first writing editor for focused fiction
records.description: Illusions is a Japanese fiction-writing editor built for uninterrupted drafting. Write vertically or horizontally, add ruby text, run Japanese proofreading, and keep every change safe with autosave and version history. Export your manuscript to PDF, EPUB, or DOCX. Available on iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux. 縦書き、ルビ、日本語校正、自動保存、履歴、PDF・EPUB・DOCX書き出しを一つに。iOS、macOS、Windows、Linux対応の日本語小説執筆エディタ。

records.name: Kanverse GPU Borrow
records.tagline: Borrow GPU compute from another device, with permission
records.description: Kanverse GPU Borrow demonstrates how a device can temporarily use GPU compute exposed by another machine through Blink Bridge. GPT-6 Astra acts as the orchestrator: it discovers the capability, inspects its state, requests explicit user authorization, invokes one bounded NVIDIA GPU workload, verifies the result, and confirms the GPU is released. The demo uses a real NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU and a live cross-device connection—not a simulated GPU.

records.name: CodaBridge
records.tagline: Hear, shape, and investigate sperm whale codas with Astra
records.description: CodaBridge lets you listen to real sperm whale recordings, shape a personal synthetic coda, compare timing patterns, and explore evidence in Context Lab. Astra can investigate the measurements using CodaBridge's evidence tools, connecting its explanations to source rows, controls, and uncertainty. The goal is to make exploration useful and traceable without treating similarity as translation.

records.name: Slurp
records.tagline: Download and record video from thousands of sites
records.description: Slurp is a native Mac app for downloading video and audio and recording live streams from thousands of sites. Paste a link and Slurp automatically tries multiple ways to find the media, including source-specific extraction, page and embedded-player discovery, direct stream detection, alternate verified engines, and browser assistance. Compatibility updates independently, and there’s no behavioural telemetry. Free trial included.

records.name: AtlasAlign
records.tagline: Align brain microscopy to an atlas, review and export ROIs
records.description: AtlasAlign is an open-source Fiji/ImageJ2 plugin for mouse brain atlas alignment and ROI export. Beta.3 adds multichannel and composite viewing, registration pinned to C/Z/T, selected-plane exports, and saved review sessions. Refine alignment, edit anatomical ROIs, and export crops and masks in original image coordinates. Resume individual or batch reviews. Source images stay read-only; researchers review and accept the anatomy. Demo frames show the earlier interface.

records.name: GameReverie
records.tagline: A Codex Skill for building and iterating games
records.description: GameReverie is an open-source Codex Skill for taking a game from idea to first playable and through ongoing iteration. It separates design, implementation, and independent review, preserves project decisions across sessions, and turns playtest feedback into follow-up work. Guide development yourself or delegate a bounded goal. Developed with GPT-6 Astra, with a playable Snake demo and development records. Free and MIT-licensed.

records.name: Ringo
records.tagline: Seamless AX Co-worker
records.description: Ringo is not just a chatbot. It proactively spots what needs to be done, suggests solutions, and automates your workflows. More than just a tool, Ringo is both a reliable teammate and an AX expert that naturally transforms how your entire organization works with AI.

records.name: AINA
records.tagline: Find your job search blind spots with an AI coach
records.description: AINA is an AI career coach that helps you see what's holding your job search back, strengthen your profile, and practice for interviews — through conversations with a video avatar. Talk to AINA and walk away with a personalized action plan for whatever's next in your career.

records.name: Pushary
records.tagline: Every agent accessible via your Mac’s notch
records.description: Pushary Isle puts Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and OpenCode in your Mac’s notch. Approve with one key, jump to the right terminal, or answer from your phone when you walk away. Native, 8 MB to download, 38 MB at rest, measured.

records.name: Wingman
records.tagline: A little nudge to text your girlfriend
records.description: You meant to text her. Then the day got busy. Wingman for iPhone brings reminders, editable message ideas, and your own drafts together. Choose your days and time, make the words yours, then open Messages or WhatsApp and tap Send yourself. No automatic texts or conversation scanning. Available in English, Spanish, French, and Brazilian Portuguese. One purchase. No subscription, account, ads, or tracking.

records.name: Forma-oss
records.tagline: urn a prompt or image into an editable hardware project
records.description: Forma turns a prompt or image into an editable hardware project with parts, wiring, mechanical layouts, cost estimates, and assembly instructions. Its open-source, local-first workspace connects supported AI agents to shared project data, rule-based electrical checks, and CAD tools. Generate concept renders, inspect the design, and revise your project as your idea evolves.

records.name: AEXGrid
records.tagline: Coordinate AI agents. From anywhere.
records.description: AEXGrid turns AI coding agents into a visual team. Bring Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode and more into one workspace, assign roles, and connect agents with collaboration links and reviewed handoffs. Ask managers to organize the work, follow task steps and file changes, dictate prompts, and access your desktop workspace remotely from your phone. Each agent keeps its own conversation while working toward a shared goal.

records.name: ContextsBase - AI Knowledge Platform
records.tagline: Your product knowledge, built for AI.
records.description: ContextsBase is a single-source context infrastructure platform (web app) that manages unified project knowledge for AI agents. Served seamlessly over MCP, it holds your specs, rules, data models, workflows, and guidelines in one place. It isn't limited to web development. Whether you're building backend APIs, mobile apps, systems software, or even managing marketing campaigns and brand engines, it acts as the central source of truth that your agents read from and report back to.

records.name: WhaleRead
records.tagline: Locally translate TXT, Markdown, and EPUB
records.description: WhaleRead is a local-first macOS reader that translates TXT, Markdown, and EPUB with on-device 7B or self-hosted 30B private models, preserves bilingual reading, and adds human-confirmed review plus Ask AI—while keeping your library under your control.

records.name: Keysake
records.tagline: Learn English as you type Chinese
records.description: Learn English as you type Chinese. Keysake is a free macOS input method that shows English alongside your Chinese. Save words, phrases, or full sentences from what you want to say. Japanese, Korean, and more languages are coming soon.

records.name: Codex GPU Queue
records.tagline: One GPU. Many Codex sessions. Less manual juggling.
records.description: My most-used local Codex tool. I use it every day to let multiple sessions share one Windows GPU. Jobs queue in the background, run when resources are available, and return results to each session, so I don't have to coordinate them manually.

records.name: DungeonQ
records.tagline: Divert suspicious sessions into persistent decoy worlds
records.description: DungeonQ diverts designated suspicious sessions into persistent synthetic worlds. Human and AI clients use world-only tickets; operators observe and approve bounded adaptation. Inspect recorded runtime checks and the original Astra experiment.

records.name: ReviewMix
records.tagline: Google reviews and testimonials, together on your site
records.description: Get more Google reviews with printable QR codes and review links, reply to every review from one inbox, and embed Google reviews on your website. EU-hosted, free tier.

records.name: Verity Score
records.tagline: Track what AI says about your store, fix it, generate blog
records.description: Verity Score tracks what six AI assistants answer about your Shopify store: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, AI Overviews and Grok. Every answer is kept verbatim, with its sources. When a page is missing a fact, Verity writes the correction from your own words. You approve it, it goes live in Shopify, and you can undo it any time. It also writes the blog articles your buyers ask for, and rewrites the ones AI cannot use. Then it measures the visits and orders AI really sent you.

records.name: Buncha Games
records.tagline: Instant-play Games & UGC Worlds for desktop & mobile web
records.description: Buncha Games is a free, instant-play browser gaming platform built for both players and creators. Alongside curated Games, the platform introduces Worlds: persistent UGC game experiences where players can create, share, discover, and play community-made content. Everything runs directly on desktop and mobile web with no downloads, combining the accessibility of browser games with the creativity and social discovery of modern UGC platforms.

records.name: Mela
records.tagline: Play with friends and AI and let the crowd change the game
records.description: Pick a game and play—no download or signup wall. Mela brings 18 browser games into one shared playground: play solo, invite friends, bring an AI agent to supported games, or join the crowd and influence the match. Run a three-game Circuit with your group, join by QR, and revisit scorecards, clips and playable memories. WebMCP and remote MCP let agents take part under the same game rules. Eighteen games is just the start.

records.name: Rolequiry
records.tagline: Know what to ask before you join
records.description: Same posting. Different priorities. Different questions. Rolequiry connects your career priorities to a job posting and helps you prepare questions to discuss with the team. It checks public sources for supporting evidence and counter-signals, separates posting evidence from your personal criteria, and turns unresolved details into interview questions. No fit score. A resume is optional.

records.name: Infinomni
records.tagline: Turn drawings into 3D creations you can play with and print
records.description: Infinomni lets anyone bring their own characters to life. Play with them in your virtual room, and 3D print them into existence. From figures to mini-robots, Infinomni designs any forms for the physical world starting with consumer hardware. Infinomni makes it fun to build things.

records.name: SmartCheck
records.tagline: Count objects in a photo with three example taps
records.description: Count materials, parts, products and crops from a photo. Tap three examples and SmartCheck detects similar objects, shows their positions, and lets you review, correct and save the result. No installation or object-specific training data needed. Try 10 counts without signing in. Built by students at Tokyo University of Science. Results depend on the objects and photo conditions.

records.name: omadesign
records.tagline: Linux creative suite for design, layout, paint & motion
records.description: omadesign is a native Linux studio for design, layout, paint, photo, and motion. One document, one layer stack. Open-source (MIT). Built for Linux designers (including Asahi / Omarchy): not GTK or Electron. Install into ~/.local and start a file. v0.5.0: Design, Layout, Pixel, Photo, and Motion with templates, brand kits, and layered file interchange. Still alpha; rough edges welcome as bug reports. Install: curl -fsSL https://omadesign.app/install | sh Site: https://omadesign.app

records.name: Snooze Files
records.tagline: Shelve messy files and restore them in one click
records.description: Snooze Files is a small Mac app that temporarily moves files out of your way and brings them back to their original location when you’re ready. Works very similarly to Gmail snooze for emails. Right-click a file in Finder, choose Snooze File and pick a time - that's it. Your file will return to the same folder after that time. It’s a simple way to clear your desktop, put a document aside, or save something for next week.

records.name: Sweep
records.tagline: Your floor turns green where you've vacuumed
records.description: Point your iPhone at the floor while you vacuum. Sweep follows the vacuum head and paints every strip you cover, right on your floor in AR. Finish and get a top-down map with the area in m². Works with any stick vacuum. No account, no video saved.

records.name: Nina's Little Universe
records.tagline: Interactive 3D space science for curious little minds
records.description: Nina's Little Universe is a handmade, interactive science world I built for my five year old daughter. Children spin Earth to discover day and night, explore Moon phases and eclipses, experiment with light, and meet planets through touch-driven missions. It's bilingual in English and Albanian, free, and requires no account. What began as a personal project for Nina is now being used in schools, helping children learn by touching, testing, and discovering instead of passively watching.

records.name: Tab Doctor
records.tagline: Closes duplicate tabs and snooze the rest
records.description: Keeps Chrome tabs healthy: open a duplicate and it switches you to the tab you already had, untouched tabs fold into a collapsed Stale group, right-click → Snooze brings a tab back later today, tomorrow or any date. Undo anything. Offline, open source.

records.name: LokalBot
records.tagline: Find what you said or saw on your Mac
records.description: Find a decision from a call, a page you had open, or what you need to follow up on. LokalBot searches meeting transcripts and screen text you choose to save, with links to the source. Free and open source for Mac. Runs locally by default.

records.name: Agent Interface
records.tagline: Give AI agents a better way to use computers
records.description: AI agents need better computer tools, not just better models. Agent Interface is an open-source layer built to cut repeated screenshots, model calls, and waiting. It reuses learned interactions, runs action-and-feedback loops locally, and asks the model when fresh judgment is needed. Start with the runnable desktop research preview, and follow the Astra/Freedoom experiments exploring control in a world that doesn't pause while AI thinks.

records.name: cubicles.lol
records.tagline: A metaverse for builders, side projects, and bad driving
records.description: Give your project a place people can walk into. Claim a cubicle, customize your space, and meet the builders next door. Race cars, go fishing, or grab a skateboard when you need a break. A multiplayer metaverse built with GPT-6 Astra. Free to explore in your browser. No download or account needed.

records.name: Holon
records.tagline: AI agents that act and follow through
records.description: Holon is a local workbench for multiple agents with ongoing responsibilities—not just one-off chats. Agents handle development, review, documentation, and operations, saving progress and resuming when tests finish, feedback arrives, or you make a decision. Check in through a terminal or browser without starting over.

records.name: Reactor Atlas
records.tagline: Every nuclear reactor on Earth, mapped since 1954
records.description: 301 nuclear sites and 779 reactor units worldwide on an interactive globe, with a timeline running from 1954 to today. Every unit has a technical record built from IAEA PRIS, Global Energy Monitor and Wikidata, cross-checked and corrected against primary sources. There's an animated wiki explaining how each reactor family works and a live signals engine that ingests public feeds to detect outages, power changes and regulatory events. Built by a nuclear engineer. Free, bilingual, no signup.

records.name: Mantle
records.tagline: Describe your logic. Generate Admin UI, MCP & WebMCP.
records.description: Mantle is an open-source service runtime and WebMCP-native Builder that turns business rules into typed schemas, views, procedures, and HTTP/MCP triggers. Design and verify a service in the browser, then hand it to a coding agent to materialize, verify, and deploy to your own Cloudflare account. The OSS, Builder, and first-class Cloudflare deployment path are live now. Mantle Cloud remains in Internal Beta with a waitlist.

records.name: GameToMac
records.tagline: Play Windows games on Mac with AI-powered compatibility
records.description: GameToMac makes Windows games playable on Apple Silicon with smooth performance and high FPS. Built with GPT-6 Astra, it already supports Age of Empires IV, Age of Empires II, Company of Heroes 3, Counter-Strike 2, Overwatch, Red Alert 2, and Generals: Zero Hour. Thousands more Windows games will become playable on Mac very soon. Mac gaming is finally becoming a reality.

records.name: Mola
records.tagline: Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain
records.description: Mola is a cozy 3D café tycoon for Android. Serve customers, hire baristas and cleaners, arrange furniture, and expand across three districts. As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

records.name: M9R
records.tagline: Multiplayer space for your AI coding agents and teams
records.description: M9R is the multiplayer layer for AI coding agents. Bring Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other supported agents into one shared workspace. Let them communicate across providers, hand work off, and let teammates join the same work instead of juggling isolated tabs. Not another model. A better place where agents work together and talk to everyone in the space.

records.name: Yoetz
records.tagline: Check to see if AI really completed a task or if it had gaps
records.description: Yoetz is a local-first, open-source work ledger for AI coding agents. An agent publishes what it did; Yoetz checks the record and issues a receipt that states what was verified, at what coverage, and what is still open. Supports Codex, Claude and Cursor

records.name: Try The Apartment
records.tagline: A real apartment in 3D, just drag furniture & see what fits
records.description: After five viewings the places blur. This is one real apartment, rebuilt in 3D with GPT-6 Astra from the owner's phone walkthrough. Orbit it, drag in 23 pieces of furniture, get warned when something won't fit, open the doors, share the link, decide together.

records.name: Polishory
records.tagline: Get a clear plan to improve your website and prevent AI slop
records.description: Website feels generic? Polishory reviews your public URL on desktop and mobile, with design scores, screenshot-backed feedback, and prioritized recommendations. See what to change in your layout, typography, and spacing, without touching your code.

records.name: Eggshell
records.tagline: Local memory for AI agents to reuse work, spend fewer tokens
records.description: Eggshell carries useful work across AI agent chats. It stores results and evidence locally, retrieves relevant memory, and helps reduce repeated investigation—without LLM calls to organize that memory.

records.name: VoiceChanger.Live
records.tagline: Sound like anime girl in realtime on your next call
records.description: Free real-time voice changer app for PC & Mac. Hundreds of community AI voices, real-time effects, soundboard, text to speech and Audio Lab — all running locally. Less than 50ms delay on ultra fast voices and quality conversions that fully change your voice even if you are singing!

records.name: Simple Commenter AI
records.tagline: Get feedback on sites and have GPT-6 Astra prep the fix
records.description: Build client websites. Get feedback on the page. Let GPT-6 Astra in Codex prepare the fix. Simple Commenter gives your agent the comment, screenshots, element details and captured JavaScript errors through MCP. You review and test the change, then ask the agent to reply and resolve the original comment.

records.name: izzit
records.tagline: One word. Three tries. Can the AI tell what you drew?
records.description: izzit gives you one word a day and three tries to draw it. A vision model tries to work out what you made — first try earns Gold, and an extra-creative one can come back Diamond. Stump it completely and you keep the Mystery card instead. Free to try; $0.99 unlocks it for good. iPhone and Android.

records.name: StillTalk
records.tagline: A photo that talks back. Live on your device, not video.
records.description: StillTalk turns one generated photo into a character that talks. Your device draws every frame live in the browser; the server sends only speech and compact movement data. Five characters, six languages, or type your own sentence. No signup. Engine built with GPT-6 Astra.

records.name: ZeroSphere
records.tagline: AI Gets Its Own Display on your own machine.
records.description: ZeroSphere gives AI its own virtual display on Windows, allowing it to operate real desktop applications while you keep using your own desktop. AI can work in its own display, interact with applications, and you can watch or take control at any time.

records.name: Second Eyes
records.tagline: Automatically shortlist photos for faster publishing
records.description: Second Eyes helps you sort photos, understand the shortlist, and make the final call. For business briefs or personal needs, see why each photo was shortlisted and what still needs checking. You decide what to publish. Explore a real media editorial project involving 404 source files, then try six public sample photos to see how your requirements reshape the shortlist. This demo uses a recorded review. No uploads yet. Would you use this with your own photos? Share your workflow in the comments.

records.name: Bring Them to Life
records.tagline: Bring your product to life with friendly animations.
records.description: Bring Them to Life helps builders make their apps feel welcoming, memorable, and personal. Turn your own mascot into expressive moments without learning animation software or piecing together AI tools. Choose from 12 reactions and get transparent WebP, Lottie, and PNG animations you can reuse again and again in any background or scenario, mobile app, web app or desktop app. Bring your own artwork or create a new mascot. Get started today with as little as $1.

records.name: Dictation API by AssemblyAI
records.tagline: Add fast, accurate dictation with a single line API call
records.description: Dictation API turns a spoken clip into finished text. Filler and false starts come out, and the output takes whatever shape you instruct: notes, a commit message, a reply to a customer. Built on Universal-3.5 Pro. 19 languages, under a second on short clips, $0.62/hr all in.

records.name: Shall We Talk
records.tagline: Voice dictation that saves transcriptions on iPhone and Mac
records.description: Shall We Talk turns speech into clean text on iPhone and Mac. Dictate into any app with a voice keyboard that types at your cursor, Shortcuts, or a Mac hotkey, and record meetings into speaker-labeled transcripts and structured summaries. Cleanup is a proofreader, not a rewriter: it removes fillers and misheard words but keeps your wording, tone and Chinese-English code-switching. Open source (GPL-3.0); bring your own speech and LLM API keys. Advanced from build 200 to 243 with GPT-6 Astra.

records.name: claudebill
records.tagline: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
records.description: Claude Code already logs every token it bills. claudebill reads those logs and shows cost per session, project, git branch, model, and day, plus what prompt caching saved you. Retroactive, offline, zero dependencies. npx claudebill.

records.name: AI Class by Kanary
records.tagline: Knight or Ninja? Your Codex & Claude logs decide
records.description: Not a quiz. AI Class reads 30 days of your real Codex and Claude Code logs and turns them into one of 16 RPG classes: Knight, Ninja, Alchemist, Guild Master and 12 more. Six stats show how you actually work: volume, autonomy, chat length, context size, cache reuse and parallelism. Paste one prompt into your agent. It aggregates your logs locally and sends only totals. Conversations, prompts and project names never leave your machine. Free. No install. Your card in about a minute.

records.name: Guild Manager
records.tagline: Run your guild in one place, inside Discord
records.description: Replace the bots and spreadsheets your guild runs on. Roster, events, attendance, loot and analytics in one app, with two-way Discord role sync, DKP auctions and voice attendance. Each game gets its own setup. Free for guilds of any size. 4,065+ guilds.

records.name: Galactic Receipt Scanner
records.tagline: Turn your phone into a hands-free receipt scanning station
records.description: Deploy your own private scanner on ChatGPT Sites. Capture receipts hands-free with your phone, then use ChatGPT Work to parse receipts and invoices. Stress-tested with 800 receipts so far and continuously improved through real-world use.

records.name: OpenAlgo Charts
records.tagline: OpenSource Charting Terminal for Financial Portals
records.description: Production-grade charts built for brokers, exchanges, trading platforms, and financial portals. Bring your own market data, plug it in, and deliver a complete charting experience without building the charting stack from scratch. Open source. Data-agnostic. Ready to integrate.

records.name: PC Anatomy
records.tagline: Explore a PC from case to GPU core in interactive 3D
records.description: PC Anatomy is an open source interactive 3D explorer for computer hardware. Take apart a desktop PC, inspect its components, and dive deeper from the motherboard, CPU, cooling, storage and GPU all the way down to GPU architecture and individual streaming multiprocessors. Every component includes explanations, specifications and sources, with all 3D geometry generated directly in TypeScript and Three.js.

records.name: Banana Keyboard
records.tagline: Insert AI prompts from your Android keyboard
records.description: An Android keyboard that puts curated AI prompts one tap away. Open it in any chat app, pick a prompt, and it is typed into the text field for you. It never presses Send. The prompt panel collapses to a slim bar the moment you insert, so the conversation and its send button stay visible. Favorites, recents and the bundled prompt library stay on your device. Free on Google Play, no account needed. A web prompt library is available too.

records.name: Unfetch.com
records.tagline: Let ChatGPT and Claude manage your ads.
records.description: Unfetch connects Google Ads, Analytics, and Search Console to the AI tools you already use. It gives ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI clients the live evidence they need to provide useful marketing answers. Use it for reporting, optimizations, alerts, monitoring and more. Works via a hosted MCP or an agent plugin (one click install)

records.name: Sutura
records.tagline: Verified self-healing CI that proves the fix
records.description: AI agents make CI pass, but a green check does not prove the failure was fixed. Sutura is a GitHub Action and CLI that reproduces the failure in an isolated sandbox, separates flakes from real failures, searches bounded repairs, rejects green-wash (deleted tests, weakened assertions, relaxed config), then puts the winner through an adversarial audit by NVIDIA Nemotron with GPT-6 Astra and TypeSafe Jev as veto-only second opinions. It opens an evidence-backed PR for a human. Never auto-merges.

records.name: TypeDash
records.tagline: Voice shortcuts and fast dictation for your desktop
records.description: TypeDash lets you control your desktop and dictate anywhere by voice. Open apps, search the web and YouTube, find files, and run voice shortcuts. Speech recognition runs locally, with optional ChatGPT Cleanup.

records.name: Loci
records.tagline: Open-source biomedical image analysis for every lab
records.description: Loci is a free, open-source desktop workspace for scientific images. View microscopy and 3D data, count cells, annotate, measure and export traceable results without a cloud account or subscription. Use built-in analysis or bring compatible model packages. Built by a researcher and shaped by real lab workflows. Currently public beta for Apple Silicon Macs; research use only.

records.name: Wombo
records.tagline: AI game studio for 2D graphics assets, sounds, and sfx
records.description: Wombo allows you to easily create sprites and sound assets for your game. It implements chroma keying so you get a sprite animation ready-to-use, but you also have native Aseprite exports ready for editing. It generates aligned side/front/back views so you can create animation sequences from any angle. Under the hood it combines GPT-Image-2.5, video generation (MiniMax H3) and ffmpeg to extract, resize and align the frames.

records.name: Ami AI
records.tagline: Lovable for getting customers
records.description: Most outbound dies on one decision: who to write to this week. Ami has already made it 17,707 times and kept score. Built on GPT-6 Astra and every one of those campaigns, it reads your website, picks the buyers who actually convert, and plans backwards from the number you need: leads, senders, weeks. If the list you asked for won't work, it says so before it builds anything. Approve the plan and it runs the outreach, watches every campaign, and fixes what slips. 19,854 booked meetings behind it.

records.name: citizen404
records.tagline: The AGI runs the world with GPT-6 Astra. Hunt citizen404!
records.description: One citizen has escaped the Supreme AGI. Take the oath, hunt them across the open web, and find out why they noticed you. citizen404 is a multiplayer manhunt run by GPT-6 Astra. This post breaks down why context compression makes Codex more efficient, more frugal, and materially cheaper to run without sacrificing useful output.

records.tagline: Turn everyday sounds into game-ready sound packs

records.name: Accounts Receivable Turnover Calculator

Analyze collection efficiency, evaluate credit policies, and assess liquidity with instant, accurate results.

Choose from 12 reactions and get transparent WebP, Lottie, and PNG animations you can reuse again and again in any background or scenario, mobile app, web app or desktop app. Bring your own artwork or create a new mascot. records.name: Unvendor
records.tagline: A shared UI between you and the AI
records.description: Unvendor turns your wishes into an interactive canvas. No more chatting: plan a trip, adjust a budget, practise a language through tools you can use and change. Keep your main activity in view, open more tools alongside it, and return to saved canvases. New and different way to interact with AI.

records.name: illusions

records.description: Illusions is a Japanese fiction-writing editor built for uninterrupted drafting. records.name: MosMos
records.tagline: Voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings
records.description: MosMos goes beyond voice dictation by turning both individual thoughts and group conversations into usable writing. Speak naturally in any app, get fast and accurate text in the style you choose, or ask MosMos to search the web for current information. Its personal glossary remembers specialized terms after you add them once. In multi-speaker meetings, it tracks precise timestamps, distinguishes speakers, and creates structured notes, summaries, decisions, and action items for easier follow-up.

records.name: Freelancer Client System

records.name: TypeDash
records.tagline: Voice shortcuts and fast dictation for your desktop
records.description: TypeDash lets you control your desktop and dictate anywhere by voice. Open apps, search the web and YouTube, find files, and run voice shortcuts. Speech recognition runs locally, with optional ChatGPT Cleanup.

records.name: AI Class by Kanary
records.tagline: Knight or Ninja? Your Codex & Claude logs decide
records.description: Not a quiz. AI Class reads 30 days of your real Codex and Claude Code logs and turns them into one of 16 RPG classes: Knight, Ninja, Alchemist, Guild Master and 12 more. It aggregates your logs locally and sends only totals. Conversations, prompts and project names never leave your machine. Free. No install. Your card in about a minute.

records.name: Mola

As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

The goal is to make exploration useful and traceable without treating similarity as translation.

records.name: Shall We Talk
records.tagline: Voice dictation that saves transcriptions on iPhone and Mac
records.description: Shall We Talk turns speech into clean text on iPhone and Mac. Dictate into any app with a voice keyboard that types at your cursor, Shortcuts, or a Mac hotkey, and record meetings into speaker-labeled transcripts and structured summaries. Open source (GPL-3.0); bring your own speech and LLM API keys. Advanced from build 200 to 243 with GPT-6 Astra.

records.name: Slurp
records.tagline: Download and record video from thousands of sites
records.description: Slurp is a native Mac app for downloading video and audio and recording live streams from thousands of sites. Compatibility updates independently, and there’s no behavioural telemetry. Free trial included.

records.name: AtlasAlign
records.tagline: Align brain microscopy to an atlas, review and export ROIs

records.name: Eggshell
records.tagline: Local memory for AI agents to reuse work, spend fewer tokens

records.name: GameReverie

It separates design, implementation, and independent review, preserves project decisions across sessions, and turns playtest feedback into follow-up work. Guide development yourself or delegate a bounded goal. Developed with GPT-6 Astra, with a playable Snake demo and development records. Free and MIT-licensed.

records.name: Home Story
records.tagline: AI that learns what you love and finds homes for your life.
records.description: Home Story goes beyond bedroom counts to find the details you actually care about: wood floors, two bathroom sinks, a walk-in pantry, or a backyard water feature. Tell Nora, your AI home search guide, what makes a house feel like home. It searches within your budget, checks listing photos and descriptions for your must-haves, and explains each home’s matches and tradeoffs.

records.name: ApplySeed
records.tagline: Raise your seed from accelerators

ApplySeed tells you what’s missing, finds programs you qualify for, and adapts your information to each application form. We fill it, you review and send it.

records.name: Ice Runner: Save Penguins
records.tagline: Free iOS game built with GPT-6 Astra. Out on the App Store.
records.description: Ice Runner is a free iOS game built with GPT-6 Astra, out now on the App Store. Complete icy levels, rescue baby penguins, and feed your 3D colony. Offline on iPhone and iPad, no account required. Android is in development and coming soon.

records.name: Second Eyes
records.tagline: Automatically shortlist photos for faster publishing
records.description: Second Eyes helps you sort photos, understand the shortlist, and make the final call. For business briefs or personal needs, see why each photo was shortlisted and what still needs checking. You decide what to publish. Explore a real media editorial project involving 404 source files, then try six public sample photos to see how your requirements reshape the shortlist. This demo uses a recorded review. records.name: Nepotism Network

records.name: Loci

records.description: XAI is an all-in-one AI platform that builds full apps, websites, and 2D/3D games from text prompts in under a minute, with seamless integration for Unity, PC, and PS5.

records.name: GymLog
records.tagline: Open-source voice + AI workout log for lifting and CrossFit
records.description: GymLog is an open-source iOS app for strength training and CrossFit WODs: supersets, drop sets, AMRAP/For Time/EMOM timers, like-for-like PRs, coach-athlete sharing and Excel/CSV import. Plan by voice and get AI reviews via your own relay. MIT.

records.tagline: Discover tools. Launch free. See what gets attention.
records.description: My Own Product is a discovery platform where builders can launch products for free and users can find useful tools through clear categories, capabilities, and use cases. No voting race, backlink requirement, analytics integration, or third-party tracking embed is needed to understand whether people are actually discovering your product.

records.name: Squishyfile MP4 to Transcript

records.description: MP4 to Transcript turns spoken video into text right in your browser — no upload, no server, no wait. records.tagline: Run field service jobs from a QR code, no app install
records.description: FieldSign runs field service end to end: work orders, asset registries, QR fault reporting, quotations, invoices, purchase orders and projects. The difference is the technician side — no app store, no seat licence, no password. Techs scan a QR code, do the job, capture the client signature on site, and a branded PDF report is emailed on completion. Flat pricing from $59/mo for the whole team, not per user. White-label, nightly encrypted backups, 14-day trial, no card.

records.name: CueMap
records.tagline: Fast, accurate and inspectable context recall for AI agents
records.description: CueMap is an open-source memory engine for AI agents, built in Rust. records.name: SceneProof
records.tagline: AI continuity supervisor for generative film
records.description: SceneProof watches your film, understands its visual and narrative context, and proposes what should stay consistent across shots. Creators confirm the canon; SceneProof then flags potential continuity issues with visual evidence and uncertainty instead of treating every difference as an error. records.name: Vocal Lesson Log
