As a trusted Texas software development company, we build secure and scalable software, web, and mobile applications based on specific business needs. Our experienced team helps Texas businesses improve operations, enhance customer experiences, and turn technology ideas into reliable digital products.

records.name: LazyLord
records.tagline: Free Overlord alternative: Figma ⇄ Adobe, as real layers
records.description: LazyLord moves artwork between Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects, in any direction. Select, press Send, and it arrives as real, editable layers: Bézier paths, live text, gradients, masks and groups, not a flat image. Send again and it updates what it built before, right where it sits, and it asks before overwriting your hand edits. Live mode keeps apps in sync as you work. Everything runs on your own computer. Free and open source.

records.name: Qahera UI Kit
records.tagline: AI-native UI engineering , Contract-Driven Design System
records.description: Qahera is an open-source, AI-native design system built for modern web development. It combines contract-driven components, design tokens, UX patterns, and AI-ready context across React, PHP, HTML, Web Components, and HTMX — with Arabic and RTL designed in from the foundation. AI-native UI engineering design system for Arabic, RTL, and multi-stack apps, Contract-Driven Design System & Multi-Target Component Architecture (React, PHP Plates, Native HTML, Web Components) - alwkala/Qahera-UI-Kit

records.name: Earrings Bali Collection
records.tagline: Elegant Bali Earrings for Every Occasion
records.description: Discover the Earrings Bali Collection by ABDesignjewellery, featuring beautiful designs that blend traditional charm with modern fashion. The collection offers elegant earrings with attractive details, making them suitable for weddings, festivals, parties, celebrations, and everyday styling. These versatile designs can complement sarees, ethnic outfits, festive wear, and contemporary dresses, helping women create a graceful and stylish appearance.

records.name: TerraNest
records.tagline: Find stays, rentals, homes and land across borders
records.description: TerraNest is a new and growing place-discovery platform for people planning a move or trip. Explore stays, rentals, homes and land, save favorites, compare places and share searches. Browsing and accounts are free. Listers pay $20/month to submit properties for verification. Some discovery listings link to official external websites; availability and terms must be confirmed with the source.

records.name: File Organizer Pro
records.tagline: Organize your files in seconds
records.description: File Organizer Pro is a simple Windows app that helps you organize your files quickly and easily. Sort your images, videos, documents, music, and archives into organized folders with just a few clicks. Features: • Drag & drop • Duplicate protection • File preview • Undo and restore • Custom categories • Simple and fast interface • Custom themes Get File Organizer Pro for only $1.99.

records.name: Meridian Reading
records.tagline: Private life-path document. Not a chat.
records.description: Meridian delivers a private structured life-path document within 48 hours: who you are, which chapter you are in, and what tends to fit next. Unlike daily astrology apps or coaching chat, you get a finished 20-section web page with conviction labels (Full / Clear / Working), a chronological map, and high-conviction forward windows. Plain language. No mystical jargon. Cross-referenced lenses, human hand-finished. For people who outgrew notification feeds and want a mirror they can return to.

records.name: PortableFix
records.tagline: Portable Windows repair toolkit that runs off a USB stick
records.description: Portable Windows 10/11 diagnostic and repair tool - PySide6 GUI, PowerShell-driven, dry-run first, no install required - vxkShelby/portableFixer

records.name: Windows 11 ARM64 on M1 Mac, not in a VM
records.tagline: Windows 11 ARM64 running on M1 Mac hardware without VM
records.description: NWOAS boots Windows 11 ARM64 on an Apple Silicon Mac's own hardware, not inside a VM. Built on m1n1 and Project Mu UEFI (via the AppleWOA forks), it currently runs Windows from an M1 Mac mini's internal SSD alongside macOS Tahoe: all 8 CPU cores active, 15 GB RAM visible, native ARM64 execution scoring 1888 in Cinebench 2026 multi-core. Still research-grade: a second Mac orchestrates boot, and native GPU, networking, standalone boot, and power management are in progress. Fully open source.

records.name: Garden鉱山新聞
records.tagline: Anti-Hallucination AI-SLOP NEWS PAPER / 反幻覚 AIスロップ新聞
records.description: Japanese AI-slop newspaper from traceable semantic seeds. Hourly odd texts move through shifting strata and fixed weekly specimens. Chaos, with provenance. 毎時生まれるAI怪文書を、動く相対地層と固定された週別標本棚から読めるGarden鉱山新聞。意味の出自の確かな構文の種だけを使って意味の接続でカオスを生む。過学習collapseへのささやかな対抗活動。

records.name: Nesqly
records.tagline: Build, governance, and track campaign links without chaos.
records.description: Nesqly gives marketers and agencies one workspace to build, standardize, governance, manage, and track campaign links across multiple clients. Create campaigns using consistent naming conventions, generate UTM-tagged and short links, reuse campaign matrices across clients, and keep every campaign URL organized in one searchable place. Nesqly also tracks clicks and campaign journeys, helping teams understand how distributed campaign links contribute to traffic and conversions.

records.name: ChapterQuest
records.tagline: The reading app where every kid writes a different ending
records.description: ChapterQuest isn't just a reading app — it's a story engine. Kids choose their path and shape every ending, but no two stories ever unfold the same way. What really sets it apart: kids can share the stories they create with the ChapterQuest community, where other kids read them, branch them, and build their own version. It's the engagement loop of scrolling — but your kid is the co-author, not the audience.

records.name: InsuMetric
records.tagline: 100% offline supply tracking & metrics
records.description: InsuMetric is a lightweight Windows app for local supply tracking and operational metrics. Built for clinics and small businesses, especially those on older hardware, it runs smoothly even on 4 GB of RAM. Key features: • 100% Offline & Private (SQLite) • Single lifetime purchase (No SaaS/subscriptions) • Customizable reports with your own logo • Portable (Zero setup required) • English & Spanish standalone versions Try the free Demo today!

records.name: Hintveil
records.tagline: AI-generated clue decks for a one-iPhone imposter game
records.description: Hintveil turns one iPhone into an imposter game for 3–12 friends. Give AI a theme and choose who’s playing, the age range, tone, and difficulty. It generates related word pairs, then checks relevance, safety, balance, and duplicates before you save and refine the deck. AI creates the content—not the suspicion; friends still give clues, debate, and vote. The offline game and decks are free. AI creation and editing require an active subscription and internet; saved decks remain playable offline.

records.name: Counterfactual
records.tagline: Test an idea against a world that can prove you wrong
records.description: Built with GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Counterfactual is a transport experiment lab where ideas face reproducible tests. Discover why a shortcut can slow everyone down, design custom networks, search road closures and upgrades, and challenge results across traffic levels. Inspect the math and export the evidence. The public demo runs deterministic simulations; live Astra hypothesis generation is optional and not connected in this release.

records.name: AgentIsland
records.tagline: Three agents running. One place to see which one needs you.
records.description: AgentIsland puts your coding agents' permission prompts in the Mac's notch. When an agent stops to ask "can I run this?", the request appears at the top of your screen with the project, the command and a countdown — answer it there and the agent carries on. Run several at once and ⌥P opens a cockpit with every session in one place, so the blocked one is never the one you forgot about. Native Swift, 5MB, no account, no telemetry. Works with 12 CLIs including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini.

records.name: ScenoraEdits
records.tagline: Turn scripts into consistent AI videos in 5 stages
records.description: Most AI video tools give you 5-second random clips with morphing characters and drifting faces. **ScenoraEdits** is built differently — structured around a rigorous 5-Stage Studio Pipeline: 1. **Script & Voiceover Sync** 2. **Scene Clustering** 3. **Video Bible Consistency** 4. **Interactive Cinema Timeline** 5. **Full HD FFmpeg Export** 💡 **Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)**: Use your own OpenAI or Fal.ai keys for unlimited generation at zero markup, or run locally on your own GPU.

records.name: VADRA
records.tagline: Proof-gated AI across models, machines, and plan capacity
records.description: VADRA is a local-first control plane for AI work across models, registered machines and user-controlled cloud runners. It keeps plan changes visible and proof-gates protected actions so repairers cannot certify their own fixes. Its usage-aware routing layer is designed to monitor connected plan capacity/reset windows and shift eligible work before a provider becomes constrained. Multi-runner control is live; capacity routing is Preview.

records.name: LVLup Props
records.tagline: Discover, research, and compete on player props
records.description: LVLup is a player prop research platform built to help sports bettors discover, analyze, and track betting opportunities faster. Explore NFL, NBA, and MLB props using hit rates, matchup data, opportunity trends, LVLup Scores, cheatsheets, and advanced analytics. You can also track bets, see what top users are playing, and compete in free contests inside the app. For our NFL launch, LVLup Premium is free through Sept 28, and we’re running $2,500 in free NFL contests (Survivor and Pick'em)!

records.name: SatyaNet — verify, don't just share
records.tagline: Social media where only YOU can delete your own posts
records.description: A truth-verification social platform with transparent moderation and appeals.Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I built SatyaNet because I was tired of seeing creators get silently shadow-banned or de-platformed with zero explanation. The core idea: moderation should be transparent, and deletion should be the author's choice — not a platform's. It's an early MVP (built solo, free-tier hosted), so it might be a little slow to wake up on the first visit — that's a free hosting quirk, not a bug!

records.name: NTP CareerOrbit AI
records.tagline: Evidence-first AI career intelligence for your next move
records.description: NTP CareerOrbit AI is an evidence-first career intelligence platform powered by GPT-6 Astra. It analyzes a candidate’s resume and target job description to reveal Career Capital, Job Fit, Skill Gaps, and realistic career opportunities. Instead of making generic recommendations, it connects every insight to evidence from the user’s experience and distinguishes verified strengths from areas that still need validation. The platform helps professionals make better career decisions.

records.name: SaaS Economics Simulator
records.tagline: The Most Comprehensive Simulator In The Public Market
records.description: Officiora SaaS Economics Simulator is an institutional-grade SaaS decision engine built to model more than metrics. It connects pricing, growth, acquisition, retention, profitability, cash, capital, valuation and risk into one dynamic economic model—then stress-tests those assumptions through scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and probabilistic simulation to help operators understand not only where their company stands, but what happens next.

records.name: Learning World
records.tagline: An AI learning world that knows when to help—and when not to
records.description: Learning World is an adaptive learning environment for data modeling. Instead of choosing hints or chatting with a tutor, learners build a model and GPT-6 Astra observes their trajectory. It decides when to stay silent, ask a Socratic question, highlight a pattern, or simulate a consequence. Learning World keeps correctness, evidence, and mastery deterministic, so AI can guide without giving away the answer. The first world teaches star schema discovery through a BikeShop dataset.

records.name: ASO Framework — Agentic Search
records.tagline: Measure how ready your brand is for agentic search
records.description: An open-source Agentic Search Optimization framework for evaluating whether AI agents can discover, understand, verify, qualify, select, and act on an entity. It turns agentic-search readiness into a measurable framework with structured criteria, scoring, evidence review, and exportable results.

records.name: AI Content Creator Starter Kit
records.tagline: A practical toolkit for creating better content with AI
records.description: AI Content Creator Starter Kit is a practical resource designed to help creators turn ideas into useful content with AI. It provides a structured starting point for planning, creating, and improving content, helping beginners work more efficiently and build a repeatable content workflow.

records.name: Discover the best AI tools in one place
records.tagline: Explore, compare and discover AI tools
records.description: 酷塔AI工具集官网收录2000+国内外优质AI人工智能工具，提供AI写作工具、AI图像工具、AI视频工具、AI办公工具、AI智能体、AI聊天助手、AI编程工具、AI设计工具、AI音频工具、AI搜索引擎、AI开发平台、AI学习网站、AI训练模型、AI内容检测、AI提示指令等分类导航。每日更新推荐最好用的AI效率工具，助您发现AI生产力神器。

records.name: Digital Identity, KYC and AML | aIDentix
records.tagline: aIDentix: identity verification for KYC & AML
records.description: aIDentix combines KYC, AML/PEP/sanctions screening, biometric liveness detection, and document verification into one platform rather than requiring separate tools. It is built specifically to meet eIDAS 2.0 and EU Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI) requirements, which is relevant for organizations operating in the EU regulatory environment. The platform is used by banks and enterprises, giving it a track record in regulated, high-volume onboarding environments.

records.name: Race Engineer v1.1: Clear Signals
records.tagline: Run the workshop. Read the data. Call the race.
records.description: Race Engineer v1.1 puts you on the pit wall instead of behind the wheel. Plan focused Setup, Fuel, or Tires runs, read telemetry, develop and compare parts, manage heat and tire wear, answer the driver's radio calls, and choose tires or fuel at pit stops across an eight-round season. Every part and strategy call changes the same deterministic car simulation, with no hidden pace bonuses. I built most of the update with GPT-6 Astra in Codex. Free for Windows.

records.name: OraVera — Precious Asset Infrastructure
records.tagline: Trust infrastructure for jewelry — verified, not just listed
records.description: OraVera isn't just another marketplace — it's trust infrastructure for jewelry, watches, and antiques. Every item gets a Quantum Passport, issued by a verified expert, before it can be bought, sold, rented, swapped, or pledged. We connect individuals, jewelers, appraisers, and institutions (banks, insurers, regulators) into one verified ecosystem across 249 jurisdictions — turning idle valuables into working, trusted assets, whatever their price. Built by a jeweler with 30 years in the industry.

records.name: ShoutUp!
records.tagline: Shout or tap to grow your pet into a planet
records.description: Shout into your mic or tap fast to grow a tiny pet all the way up to the size of planet Earth. Two modes, one giant goal: Shout Mode turns your voice into growth in real time, Tap Mode gives you fast-tap challenges for quiet moments. Growth is measured in real kilometers relative to Earth's diameter — start as a pebble, aim for the planet.

records.name: Kennel by Waldo
records.tagline: More intelligence. Less for you to carry.
records.description: Tell Kennel your goal and it does the rest. Say "make a blue circle" - Kennel works out the size, colour, placement from what the project already knows. It forms a contract, and hands each piece of the goal to the best agents available (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, etc) under authority you grant / revoke. It manages the agent coordination and brings back what needs your judgment, and what's still open. No more babysitting agents or forgetting what you set out to do.

records.name: Autonomized.io
records.tagline: YOUR BUSINESS NOW RUNS ITSELF.
records.description: Not just a "CRM". Not just a stack of tools you have to learn to use and operate manually. Not just an AI chatbot or another “AI employee” bolted on top of your business. Autonomized.io offers something different. Full business autonomy. A bold claim that's now a reality. With Autonomized, your business can now run itself. From sourcing leads to end-to-end sales paired with zero manual data entry + so much more.. Everyone sells automation. We sell autonomy. Learn the difference. — Autonomized.io

records.name: BBSide
records.tagline: An AI-powered platform for local businesses
records.description: BBSide combines capabilities that competitors usually separate: AI-generated business pages, service bookings, product orders, payments, customer communication, multilingual local discovery, and dynamic geolocation. Unlike booking-first platforms, every provider receives a shareable storefront that delivers value even before the marketplace reaches scale. Providers can acquire customers through social media, messages, referrals, and search while becoming part of a live local network.

records.name: Xingxu
records.tagline: Explore Chinese astrology in an interactive 3D universe
records.description: Step into a living starfield and explore two Chinese divination traditions: Bazi birth charts and Da Liu Ren question readings. Enter your birth details or ask about a situation, watch the celestial rings move, and read clear, practical interpretations. Switch between English and Chinese without losing your place. Save readings in your browser and revisit them later. Free to try, with no account or installation required.

records.name: ChatGPT and Claude Context Transfer
records.tagline: Switch your context between Claude and ChatGPT in minutes
records.description: I show a practical workflow for moving useful context from Claude to ChatGPT without copying your full chat history. First, I export what Claude knows from memory and past chats, review outdated details, and turn the useful parts into a portable Markdown profile. Then I upload that profile to a new ChatGPT chat, check what it understood, and update the memory I want ChatGPT to keep. The goal is to avoid starting from zero whenever you switch assistants.

records.name: PaperTodo
records.tagline: Turn a sticky note into a tool of your own
records.description: PaperTodo is fast, lightweight, and always within reach on your Windows desktop. Jot down notes and to-dos, then fold or dock each paper out of the way. Make it yours with custom plugins you can create using Astra.

records.name: Ink Player
records.tagline: Most innovative video player for WordPress
records.description: Most WordPress video plugins just play a file. Ink Player turns video into a channel: capture emails mid-video, run pre-roll ads with VAST tags, add chapters, timestamps, and password protection. Then stream from YouTube, Vimeo, Bunny, Cloudflare, or Mux with real analytics behind it. Built for creators who have stopped treating video as decoration and started treating it as a funnel. And it doesn't just play video. Add audio and turn it into a powerful podcast player.

records.name: Agent Gate
records.tagline: Control AI agents before they take risky actions
records.description: Agent Gate is a control layer for AI agents, designed to stop risky actions before they happen. It evaluates agent behavior with GPT-6 Astra, applies policies, assigns risk scores, and can allow, block, or require human approval in real time. Unlike basic monitoring tools, Agent Gate actively governs agent actions and keeps a clear audit trail of every decision.

records.name: Pushary
records.tagline: Every agent accessible via your Mac’s notch
records.description: Pushary Isle puts Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and OpenCode in your Mac’s notch. Approve with one key, jump to the right terminal, or answer from your phone when you walk away. Native, 8 MB to download, 38 MB at rest, measured.

records.name: Wingman
records.tagline: A little nudge to text your girlfriend
records.description: You meant to text her. Then the day got busy. Wingman for iPhone brings reminders, editable message ideas, and your own drafts together. Choose your days and time, make the words yours, then open Messages or WhatsApp and tap Send yourself. No automatic texts or conversation scanning. Available in English, Spanish, French, and Brazilian Portuguese. One purchase. No subscription, account, ads, or tracking.

records.name: 深層避難所
records.tagline: 地表有許多殭屍 需要跑到地底生存
records.description: 新的玩法不同的樣貌

records.name: Grabl
records.tagline: A shelf for files in progress. Holds them till you need them
records.description: Moving one file between two apps shouldn't mean digging through Downloads. Grabl is an always-on-top shelf pinned to your screen edge: drag files, links, and images in, keep them in folders, and drag them out into any app. Hotkey or mouse-shake to summon.

records.name: Reactor Atlas
records.tagline: Every nuclear reactor on Earth, mapped since 1954
records.description: 301 nuclear sites and 779 reactor units worldwide on an interactive globe, with a timeline running from 1954 to today. Every unit has a technical record built from IAEA PRIS, Global Energy Monitor and Wikidata, cross-checked and corrected against primary sources. There's an animated wiki explaining how each reactor family works and a live signals engine that ingests public feeds to detect outages, power changes and regulatory events. Built by a nuclear engineer. Free, bilingual, no signup.

records.name: TutorLM
records.tagline: Learn AI from a tutor who talks, draws and checks you got it
records.description: tutorLM is a live AI tutor for learning AI. Andrew teaches one idea at a time, draws it on the canvas as he talks, answers when you interrupt, and checks you understood before moving on. 23 lessons, one credential. Start free, no card.

records.name: Tako by Atomli
records.tagline: Fastest, lightest quantum chemistry simulation.
records.description: Tako is a browser-local atomistic simulation workspace for quantum chemistry. Tako included a native jupyter notebook like interface and rich agentic support, making quantum chemistry more approachable. The underlaying chemistry Atomli reduced DFT compute by more then 10x without any compromise on accuracy, reduce compute cost.

records.name: Conviction
records.tagline: Your private AI investment committee, that shows its work
records.description: Conviction is a source-grounded AI investment committee. Upload diligence docs, and six independent specialist agents review them in parallel, with zero visibility into each other's output. Every factual claim must cite a specific document page or it fails validation. A Chair agent then synthesizes the reports into one recommendation, fully traceable back to source. Decision support for investors, angels, not investment advice.

records.name: Forma-oss
records.tagline: urn a prompt or image into an editable hardware project
records.description: Forma turns a prompt or image into an editable hardware project with parts, wiring, mechanical layouts, cost estimates, and assembly instructions. Its open-source, local-first workspace connects supported AI agents to shared project data, rule-based electrical checks, and CAD tools. Generate concept renders, inspect the design, and revise your project as your idea evolves.

records.name: ResumeUp.AI
records.tagline: AI job search agent. Finds it, tailors it, applies for you.
records.description: An AI agent that runs the whole loop. It continuously watches 100K+ job boards and ATS systems and pulls new roles into your feed as soon as they go live. Each one is matched to your profile on role, keywords, semantic fit and location, so you only see jobs you'd actually get. For every match it tailors your resume to that listing, with you choosing which skills to include, then auto-applies on your behalf. Built on the ATS-tested resume builder 500K+ job seekers already use.

records.name: Familia
records.tagline: Plans, tasks, and everything a family calendar can't hold
records.description: Familia is an iPhone app for plans, tasks, shared responsibilities, lists, and recurring reminders. Capture things by voice, text, or photo and turn them into something actionable. Built by AI. Stress tested by a family of six humans.

records.name: OrbitRabbit
records.tagline: Explore China’s space industry, with sources
records.description: OrbitRabbit brings together research on Chinese satellites, ground stations and space companies, with source links and evidence notes. Built with GPT-6 Astra across much of its development. Explore public records and a free English research sample.

records.name: Periodica
records.tagline: Your wallpaper renders forever. Bake it once.
records.description: Deterministic animation baking. WPE Baker, the first Periodica product, models a Wallpaper Engine scene's animation math and retunes its periods until everything closes into one baked loop, look unchanged. Up to 96% less GPU load and power, even on battery.

records.name: Astra State Orchestrator
records.tagline: Stateful AI orchestration powered by GPT-6 Astra
records.description: A stateful AI application built with GPT-6 Astra. Natural-language input is interpreted by Astra, processed through a stateful orchestration runtime, and returned as a clear result through a live web interface. The system separates language reasoning from deterministic state processing, enabling persistent event handling, controlled state transitions, and explicit runtime decisions.

records.name: AEXGrid
records.tagline: Coordinate AI agents. From anywhere.
records.description: AEXGrid turns AI coding agents into a visual team. Bring Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode and more into one workspace, assign roles, and connect agents with collaboration links and reviewed handoffs. Ask managers to organize the work, follow task steps and file changes, dictate prompts, and access your desktop workspace remotely from your phone. Each agent keeps its own conversation while working toward a shared goal.

records.name: Pagepod
records.tagline: Save, Run, and Share Your HTML Apps Free & Get Links
records.description: Pagepod is a zero-config hosting and showcase platform for HTML web applications. Safely save, run, and share your interactive tools, games, and frontend creations in an isolated sandbox with instant previews and clean embeddable widgets

records.name: Boundless
records.tagline: Let your agent use any API. You stay in control.
records.description: Tell your agent what you want done. Boundless lets it work with APIs without you reading docs or writing integrations. Your agent figures out the details, you grant access, and useful workflows become tools you can use again.

records.name: Tend Life
records.tagline: Stop juggling 5 apps. Tend to your life in one.
records.description: Track your health (steps, water, workouts), manage your money (budgets, bills, debts, net worth), build habits that stick, check in on your mood, plan your day, and keep on top of life admin. All without the noise of five separate apps competing for your attention. No gamification gimmicks, no notification overload. Just an honest, quiet place to see where things stand, one day at a time.

records.name: ALO Locksmith Services Manhattan NYC
records.tagline: Trusted Locksmith & Home Security Solutions
records.description: Fast, dependable locksmith service in Manhattan for lockouts, rekeying, repairs, and more. Call ALO Locksmith today for prompt local help!

records.name: WorkElate Chief V0.9
records.tagline: AI Native office suite of apps for next generation of work
records.description: The office suite that doesn't need a maintainer. Chat, tasks, docs, mail, sheets and calendar on one graph, so an instruction in chat becomes an owned task that chases itself. No copilot bolted on. Used by 10+ teams. Bootstrapped, and building the last tool your team has to maintain.

records.name: Xnata Platform
records.tagline: ecommerce
records.description: Xnata is a supply-backed commerce platform that helps you launch and run a product business. It starts with vetted China-based categories, suppliers, and terms, then gives you prepared product data to assemble a catalog and publish a branded web storefront. You manage customers, orders, and integrations in a single workspace. The initial focus spans tea, tableware, and fabric, with expansion planned by vertical and country so operations grow alongside proven demand.

records.name: MyPawBro
records.tagline: Local pet communities built around trust, not transactions
records.description: MyPawBro turns local pet care into a neighbourhood community. Create a Pawfile, discover compatible local Paws, explore paw-friendly places and connect through your local Bro. Built around trusted relationships and reciprocal support rather than anonymous pet-care listings, MyPawBro brings pets and people together locally.

records.name: Start This Task
records.tagline: One startable step first, then a full editable AI plan.
records.description: Start This Task helps when a task feels too large or unclear to begin. It gives you one concrete action first, then builds a full editable plan. Choose Standard, Small, or Tiny steps, break down any step again, and use Focus Mode with an adjustable countdown timer.

records.name: Codex Insights
records.tagline: Private how-you-work reports from local Codex sessions
records.description: $insights is a community Codex plugin that reports how you work from local sessions. Default is local-only: no model calls, credential redaction, and Trust & Coverage. Built with GPT-6 Astra. Inspired by Claude Code /insights.

records.name: Deathday
records.tagline: Live a historical life in 5 minutes
records.description: A free text-based historical life simulator. Born in 1900, live through the century's wars and famines in five minutes, then share the tombstone. A new shared life every day. No signup, plays in the browser.

records.name: Praxis Gala
records.tagline: A living gallery of playable worlds and creative tools
records.description: Praxis Gala is a gallery where the exhibits actually work. Walk between creative studios, playable games, a reading room, and historical art, film, and voices. Create a world draft in the Maker Studio, then open that same saved revision in the Game Studio. The distinction is the connected experience: tools and creations share a navigable place rather than disappearing into separate tabs. It runs in your browser, with downloadable work and hidden rooms worth discovering.

records.name: meddybookAI
records.tagline: Your health records, one living timeline, powered by AI
records.description: meddybookAI brings medical reports, prescriptions and health data into one living timeline. AI organizes your records, highlights important changes and helps you understand your health. Securely share your history with a QR code. Free to start.

records.name: VoicEra
records.tagline: Describe it. Hear it. Deploy it.
records.description: VoicEra — plug in any LLM, any modelany telephony stack. Ship a voice AI agent in hours, not days. Build, test, and deploy multilingual agents with swappable LLM, STT, TTS, and telephony components. Connect your knowledge, switch languages mid-call, monitor conversations, and deploy on cloud or on-prem — with no vendor lock-in.

records.name: Margarita
records.tagline: A first-person bar game where every pour changes the score
records.description: Margarita turns cocktail making into a small first-person skill game. Pick your ingredients, choose your own amounts, add ice, shake whenever you want, and serve when you think the Margarita is ready. The game tracks your choices, dilution, temperature, shaking, and mistakes, then scores the final drink from 1–10. It uses interactive 3D bar tools, real-world-inspired ingredients, touch controls, and device-motion shaking on mobile.

records.name: TapTick
records.tagline: The swiss army knife for Mac
records.description: An app launcher, script runner, menu bar customizer, and utilities hub. The swiss army knife for Mac. TapTick brings four essential Mac workflows together: - Applications: Launch, focus, or hide any app with a global shortcut. - Scripts: Write scripts then run them globally or display result in menu bar. - Menu Bar: Show live script output in customizable one-line or two-line slots. - Utilities: Keep focused Mac tools one shortcut away. Screen capture and mark, Large Type, and Keystroke Overlay.

records.name: Relay
records.tagline: A workspace for Video Editors
records.description: Relay is a workspace for freelance video editors to manage projects, deadlines, client feedback, and payments in one place. Built around editing workflows, it connects each project to its client, deliverables, and review process. Start locally without an account or sign in to sync your work. Launching with a Free plan, built with help from GPT-6 Astra.

records.name: OutlierKit
records.tagline: Make Claude your YouTube Strategist
records.description: OutlierKit helps creators, businesses and agencies grow on YouTube. You enter one channel from your niche. Competitor Studio scans thousands of channels in that space and shows you who leads it, which titles and lengths earn the most views, which brands sponsor there, how those channels make money, and topics nobody has covered yet. Our MCP connector brings the same data into Claude, so you can just ask. The API serves it over REST. We use public YouTube data. You never connect your channel.

records.name: RevGuard
records.tagline: Bring back the customers a failed card quietly took
records.description: Self-hosted customer recovery for Stripe subscriptions, PayPal covered. It reads the real decline code, runs its own retry schedule (including the cards Stripe's retries skip), emails customers in your name with a fresh card-update link, re-checks before every send, and shows why customers slip on a dashboard served by your own n8n. New: an observe-only mode that watches for two weeks, sends nothing, and writes you a loss report. Pay $249 once. Your billing data never leaves your machine.

records.name: Cluster Atlas
records.tagline: Your map to Supercomputing Clusters.
records.description: Explore public HPC cluster architectures, node hardware and interconnects. Interactive diagrams with sourced specifications.

records.name: COREY
records.tagline: Check and fix IFC model data *visually* in your browser
records.description: COREY helps BIM teams review IFC building data in 3D, configure checks, and find missing or incorrect values. Filter problem elements in a data table, export to Excel for bulk edits, import the changes, and validate again. Visual. Simple. Reuseable. Free and open source.

records.name: ContextsBase - AI Knowledge Platform
records.tagline: Your product knowledge, built for AI.
records.description: ContextsBase is a single-source context infrastructure platform (web app) that manages unified project knowledge for AI agents. Served seamlessly over MCP, it holds your specs, rules, data models, workflows, and guidelines in one place. It isn't limited to web development. Whether you're building backend APIs, mobile apps, systems software, or even managing marketing campaigns and brand engines, it acts as the central source of truth that your agents read from and report back to.

records.name: RocketDrop
records.tagline: A shared clipboard and file drop for any two computers
records.description: Open RocketDrop on two computers and pair with a six digit code. Move clipboard text and files without installing anything or making an account. Optional Smart Handoff uses GPT-6 Astra to turn reviewed project context into a concise summary for the other computer. Bring your own OpenAI API key; clipboard and file transfer need no key.

records.name: WhaleRead
records.tagline: Locally translate TXT, Markdown, and EPUB
records.description: WhaleRead is a local-first macOS reader that translates TXT, Markdown, and EPUB with on-device 7B or self-hosted 30B private models, preserves bilingual reading, and adds human-confirmed review plus Ask AI—while keeping your library under your control.

records.name: Keysake
records.tagline: Learn English as you type Chinese
records.description: Learn English as you type Chinese. Keysake is a free macOS input method that shows English alongside your Chinese. Save words, phrases, or full sentences from what you want to say. Japanese, Korean, and more languages are coming soon.

records.name: my21reset
records.tagline: Meals + movement plan that lives & adapts in your calendar
records.description: Most meal planners give you another app to check. My21Reset creates a personalised weekly plan around your eating style, preferences and routine and then puts it directly into the calendar you already use. Get meals each week with recipes and ingredients in every breakfast, lunch and dinner event alongside gentle workouts, walks and water reminders. Swap meals whenever you like and your shopping list automatically updates organised by aisle. Every week learns from what you did.

records.name: WriteIDE
records.tagline: A desktop studio for LitRPG and progression-fantasy authors.
records.description: WriteIDE is a free, local writing studio built for LitRPG authors. Your book stays on your machine: no account required to write. Characters, scenes, and story structure live in one focused workspace instead of a pile of Google Docs. We treat Word/DOCX as a real author workflow (import and round-trip), not an afterthought. AI isn’t the product or the paywall, desktop stays free.

records.name: Compression near WinRar but 4x faster
records.tagline: Compresses 4-6x faster than WinRaR near the same size
records.description: we get within 3% of WinRaR's Size but we compress 4-6x times faster, and use 15-20x times less ram during compression, the EXE will be released within a day or two, the compressor is currently available online at https://noethix.com/compression (will be back online in launch day) we benchmarked it by CPU seconds it takes to compress, both ran on single thread We used GPT-6 Astra to heavily optimize it I would guess about 1B+ tokens were used

records.name: Codex GPU Queue
records.tagline: One GPU. Many Codex sessions. Less manual juggling.
records.description: My most-used local Codex tool. I use it every day to let multiple sessions share one Windows GPU. Jobs queue in the background, run when resources are available, and return results to each session, so I don't have to coordinate them manually.

records.name: FoodLens AI: Nutrition Scanner
records.tagline: Simply scan a food product barcode at home or while shopping
records.description: FoodLens Nutrition AI Scanner lets you scan food barcodes and get a mathematical AI-powered FoodLens Score from 1-100. Understand nutrition, ingredients, and make healthier choices.

records.name: Simple Commenter AI
records.tagline: Get feedback on sites and have GPT-6 Astra prep the fix
records.description: Build client websites. Get feedback on the page. Let GPT-6 Astra in Codex prepare the fix. Simple Commenter gives your agent the comment, screenshots, element details and captured JavaScript errors through MCP. You review and test the change, then ask the agent to reply and resolve the original comment.

records.name: Sutura
records.tagline: Verified self-healing CI that proves the fix
records.description: AI agents make CI pass, but a green check does not prove the failure was fixed. Sutura is a GitHub Action and CLI that reproduces the failure in an isolated sandbox, separates flakes from real failures, searches bounded repairs, rejects green-wash (deleted tests, weakened assertions, relaxed config), then puts the winner through an adversarial audit by NVIDIA Nemotron with GPT-6 Astra and TypeSafe Jev as veto-only second opinions. It opens an evidence-backed PR for a human. Never auto-merges.

records.name: DungeonQ
records.tagline: Divert suspicious sessions into persistent decoy worlds
records.description: DungeonQ diverts designated suspicious sessions into persistent synthetic worlds. Human and AI clients use world-only tickets; operators observe and approve bounded adaptation. Inspect recorded runtime checks and the original Astra experiment.

records.name: Chibiiq
records.tagline: Create & Edit Anime Art and Video by Chatting
records.description: Chat with Chibiiq's AI anime agent to generate anime art, characters and video from text — or turn your photos into anime style. Edit by talking. Free to start.

records.name: VoiceChanger.Live
records.tagline: Sound like anime girl in realtime on your next call
records.description: Free real-time voice changer app for PC & Mac. Hundreds of community AI voices, real-time effects, soundboard, text to speech and Audio Lab — all running locally. Less than 50ms delay on ultra fast voices and quality conversions that fully change your voice even if you are singing!

records.name: izzit
records.tagline: One word. Three tries. Can the AI tell what you drew?
records.description: izzit gives you one word a day and three tries to draw it. A vision model tries to work out what you made — first try earns Gold, and an extra-creative one can come back Diamond. Stump it completely and you keep the Mystery card instead. Free to try; $0.99 unlocks it for good. iPhone and Android.

records.name: SmartCheck
records.tagline: Count objects in a photo with three example taps
records.description: Count materials, parts, products and crops from a photo. Tap three examples and SmartCheck detects similar objects, shows their positions, and lets you review, correct and save the result. No installation or object-specific training data needed. Try 10 counts without signing in. Built by students at Tokyo University of Science. Results depend on the objects and photo conditions.

records.name: Rolequiry
records.tagline: Know what to ask before you join
records.description: Same posting. Different priorities. Different questions. Rolequiry connects your career priorities to a job posting and helps you prepare questions to discuss with the team. It checks public sources for supporting evidence and counter-signals, separates posting evidence from your personal criteria, and turns unresolved details into interview questions. No fit score. A resume is optional.

records.name: Mela
records.tagline: Play with friends and AI and let the crowd change the game
records.description: Pick a game and play—no download or signup wall. Mela brings 18 browser games into one shared playground: play solo, invite friends, bring an AI agent to supported games, or join the crowd and influence the match. Run a three-game Circuit with your group, join by QR, and revisit scorecards, clips and playable memories. WebMCP and remote MCP let agents take part under the same game rules. Eighteen games is just the start.

records.name: Buncha Games
records.tagline: Instant-play Games & UGC Worlds for desktop & mobile web
records.description: Buncha Games is a free, instant-play browser gaming platform built for both players and creators. Alongside curated Games, the platform introduces Worlds: persistent UGC game experiences where players can create, share, discover, and play community-made content. Everything runs directly on desktop and mobile web with no downloads, combining the accessibility of browser games with the creativity and social discovery of modern UGC platforms.

records.name: Mizuki: Crowned by Moonlight
records.tagline: 3D web extraction game with Astra, PlayCanvas, WebGPU & Rive
records.description: Mizuki: Crowned by Moonlight is a 3D browser-based extraction game. Explore, fight, and gather loot, then choose whether to push your luck or escape with your rewards. Built with Astra, PlayCanvas, WebGPU, and Rive, it brings risk-and-reward gameplay directly to the web. Play in a WebGPU-compatible browser, with no installation required.

records.name: Verity Score
records.tagline: Track what AI says about your store, fix it, generate blog
records.description: Verity Score tracks what six AI assistants answer about your Shopify store: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, AI Overviews and Grok. Every answer is kept verbatim, with its sources. When a page is missing a fact, Verity writes the correction from your own words. You approve it, it goes live in Shopify, and you can undo it any time. It also writes the blog articles your buyers ask for, and rewrites the ones AI cannot use. Then it measures the visits and orders AI really sent you.

records.name: ProductFight
records.tagline: Two products enter. Votes decide who wins.
records.description: Two products face off, votes decide via Elo — never who paid more. A great place for founders to get real visibility and honest feedback on their idea.

records.name: Vibit
records.tagline: Turn ideas to ADs
records.description: Vibit is an AI ad generator that turns your script into a high-converting 30–60 second video ad in minutes. Storyboard-driven AI video ads powered by Gemini & Veo — consistent characters, cinematic quality, ready for TikTok, Instagram & YouTube. Start free.

records.name: JOCOP
records.tagline: Job Outreach Copilot
records.description: Turn your resume and any job posting into an instant fit verdict, gap analysis, and high-converting personalized LinkedIn & employee referral outreach templates.

records.name: Kinnetly
records.tagline: Visual CRM - A visual map of your professional relationships
records.description: Kinnetly is a private personal CRM built around a visual graph. Kinnetly maps your relationships, introductions, meeting context and follow-ups, so you can remember who you know, how you met and what to do next. Get started free (no credit card required, no time limit). Upgrade to Standard or Pro plans if you need more included (see pricing page on the Kinnetly website).

records.name: SmartHomeXa
records.tagline: Smart Home Compatibility Checker & Builder:
records.description: Never gamble on smart home gear. SmartHomeXa tests protocol radio standards, calculates budget-tailored packages, and generates verified automation blueprints across Apple Home, Google, Alexa, and SmartThings.

records.name: ReviewMix
records.tagline: Google reviews and testimonials, together on your site
records.description: Get more Google reviews with printable QR codes and review links, reply to every review from one inbox, and embed Google reviews on your website. EU-hosted, free tier.

records.name: TastySave
records.tagline: Save recipes from videos, links & screenshots with AI
records.description: TastySave turns recipe links, social media videos, websites, and screenshots into clean, organized recipes. Save recipes from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and more, then easily cook from them later. With AI-powered extraction, smart quantity scaling, recipe organization, and a built-in shopping list, TastySave keeps everything in one place.

records.name: omadesign
records.tagline: Linux creative suite for design, layout, paint & motion
records.description: omadesign is a native Linux studio for design, layout, paint, photo, and motion. One document, one layer stack. Open-source (MIT). Built for Linux designers (including Asahi / Omarchy): not GTK or Electron. Install into ~/.local and start a file. v0.5.0: Design, Layout, Pixel, Photo, and Motion with templates, brand kits, and layered file interchange. Still alpha; rough edges welcome as bug reports. Install: curl -fsSL https://omadesign.app/install | sh Site: https://omadesign.app

records.name: Prism
records.tagline: Make Codex feel like your space
records.description: A free, open-source Windows app for personalizing Codex with themes and local backgrounds. Start with Beach or Forest, tune fading per pane, save setups, or use your own image.

records.name: Snooze Files
records.tagline: Shelve messy files and restore them in one click
records.description: Snooze Files is a small Mac app that temporarily moves files out of your way and brings them back to their original location when you’re ready. Works very similarly to Gmail snooze for emails. Right-click a file in Finder, choose Snooze File and pick a time - that's it. Your file will return to the same folder after that time. It’s a simple way to clear your desktop, put a document aside, or save something for next week.

records.name: Sweep
records.tagline: Your floor turns green where you've vacuumed
records.description: Point your iPhone at the floor while you vacuum. Sweep follows the vacuum head and paints every strip you cover, right on your floor in AR. Finish and get a top-down map with the area in m². Works with any stick vacuum. No account, no video saved.

records.name: Nina's Little Universe
records.tagline: Interactive 3D space science for curious little minds
records.description: Nina's Little Universe is a handmade, interactive science world I built for my five year old daughter. Children spin Earth to discover day and night, explore Moon phases and eclipses, experiment with light, and meet planets through touch-driven missions. It's bilingual in English and Albanian, free, and requires no account. What began as a personal project for Nina is now being used in schools, helping children learn by touching, testing, and discovering instead of passively watching.

records.name: Tab Doctor
records.tagline: Closes duplicate tabs and snooze the rest
records.description: Keeps Chrome tabs healthy: open a duplicate and it switches you to the tab you already had, untouched tabs fold into a collapsed Stale group, right-click → Snooze brings a tab back later today, tomorrow or any date. Undo anything. Offline, open source.

records.name: EumStudio
records.tagline: A local-first writing studio for long-form fiction.
records.description: Contribute to EUM27/eum.studio development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: Knarf Archive – Astra Challenge
records.tagline: Turning a real-world archive into a verifiable AI index.
records.description: ChatGPT Work with GPT-6 Astra was tasked with structuring a real-world archive of 1,225 files across 97 folders, protecting existing numbering, assigning consecutive numbers to previously unnumbered records, identifying duplicates, and building a verifiable central index. The long-running task became a real-world test of autonomous work, persistent checkpoints, interruption recovery, and state transparency.

records.name: Compra tu día app
records.tagline: Compra un día de tu vida
records.description: Compra un día de tu vida. Publica algo especial que marcó ese día para siempre y comparte con el resto del mundo. Dedica un día a alguien especial...

records.name: Service Level Objectives · Dash0
records.tagline: Reliability is a budget. Spend it on purpose.
records.description: Observability-first development for teams shipping AI-generated code. SLOs in Dash0 turn "is it reliable enough?" into one number the whole company agrees on: a target, a rolling window, and an error budget you spend on purpose. Predictive burn-rate alerts catch a slow leak before users do and page only when it is a fire. Align engineering to business goals, release with confidence, and see exactly what every deploy cost you. Now generally available. 25 SLOs per organization, included.

records.name: Earth is Optional
records.tagline: An offline space exploration game for Android
records.description: Explore planets, moons and spacecraft at your own pace. Take the controls, inspect what you find and earn rewards for each discovery. An offline Android space game built with GPT-6 Astra. Free early access with 30 destinations and 3 hours of fast-track credit.

records.name: LoomBox
records.tagline: One quiet inbox for everything you save. No account needed.
records.description: Links, reels, PDFs, screenshots, places — you save them all day and can never find them again. LoomBox is one inbox for all of it: share anything from any app and it's saved, auto-categorised and searchable. Zero onboarding, no account, no server, no tracking — everything stays on your device. Live Activity download progress, iPhone/iPad/Mac, iCloud sync in Pro. Built solo in SwiftUI with zero dependencies.

records.name: Marketing Commander powered by Lumen
records.description: Turn one brief into campaign direction, channel-specific draft copy and images. Marketing Commander orchestrates AI workflows with human approval on every draft. Play store publishing rights have been granted. I am perfectionalising everything for release this week.

records.name: MirageUI
records.tagline: Beautiful, open-source & accessible UI components in 1 click
records.description: MirageUI is a 100% open-source, lightweight library built by the team at Spacerock. It eliminates frontend friction by providing gorgeous, fully accessible UI components and fluid animations that you can preview instantly and copy-paste right into your builds. Zero configuration required.

records.name: CleanSlop
records.tagline: Ship vibe-coded apps with confidence
records.description: CleanSlop helps you ship vibe-coded TypeScript apps with confidence. Sign in with GitHub, connect your repos and run a scan. It maps the codebase (call paths, module dependencies, background jobs, data stores, external services) and surfaces the problems that matter: things that work in a demo but break with real users, like unbounded work, slow operations blocking a request, and jobs that quietly get dropped. You get a short list of real risks worth fixing, not hundreds of findings to triage.

records.name: Funny Guys
records.tagline: Fast, funny multiplayer obstacle battles for mobile
records.description: Funny Guys is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where players race through chaotic obstacle courses, survive mini-games, and compete to be the last one standing. Recently, we’ve been using GPT-6 Astra across development: creating character concepts, building a 148-character 3D pipeline with Blender MCP, rebuilding the entire UI, improving bot feedback, expanding online play, analyzing bugs, and preparing new maps.

records.name: BlueFlash
records.tagline: Complete aviation tutor
records.description: BlueFlash — voice-first AI tutor for DGCA CPL and ATPL ground school in India. DGCA online classes, DGCA self study, Air Navigation, Meteorology, Regulations, Technical General — plus India's first RTR simulator with live ATC voice practice on ERC-INDIA charts.

records.name: mosaic
records.tagline: Your All-in-one Media Library: Track & Discover Media
records.description: 🎬 📺 🎮 📚 Everything you love. One beautiful library. mosaic brings your movies, TV shows, games, and books together in one personal library. Track what you're watching, playing, and reading, organize your backlog, discover what's next, and keep up with upcoming releases. Connect services like Steam, GOG, Epic, Goodreads, Letterboxd, Netflix, Trakt, and more, so your collection is ready to explore from day one.

records.name: PDF-VC
records.tagline: Private offline PDF workspace, alternative to Acrobat
records.description: PDF-VC is a 100% offline PDF workspace for Windows 10/11. Compose and reorder pages visually, edit vector text blocks and images, run multilingual OCR, add Bates numbering, permanently redact sensitive data, inspect PAdES signatures, convert to PDF/A, compare documents and handle CMYK prepress—all locally, with zero cloud uploads. Built for professionals who need powerful PDF workflows without sending confidential documents to third-party servers.

records.name: Pety animalerie en ligne au Maroc
records.tagline: PETY est une animalerie en ligne au Maroc
records.description: PETY animalerie en ligne au Maroc. Croquettes, alimentation, jouets et accessoires pour chiens, chats, oiseaux et rongeurs. Livraison rapide à Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech et partout au Maroc.

records.name: BuildPeek
records.tagline: Find Docker build-secret risks, without uploading your code
records.description: Review Dockerfiles and image history for secret-like patterns locally in your browser. Get clear next steps, export an input-free report, and share a summary card. Free, no account. Built with GPT-6 Astra; no runtime AI calls.

records.name: SVDownloader
records.tagline: Free universal social video & audio downloader, zero ads
records.description: SVDownloader Web is a high-speed, privacy-first web utility for downloading videos, reels, shorts, stories, and audio tracks from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and 1000+ platforms without intrusive ads, popups, or user tracking. Supports HD/4K quality and instant MP3 extraction.

records.name: Natural Disaster Map
records.tagline: Every earthquake, wildfire and storm on one live map
records.description: Quakes live on USGS, fires on FIRMS, cyclones on NHC. Natural Disaster Map puts them on one canvas. • Earthquakes, wildfires, storms, volcanoes, floods and droughts, live • Cyclone advisories and forecast tracks • Satellite and infrared imagery (GOES, EUMETSAT, NASA GIBS) plus 10m winds • Replay the last 24h, 3d or 7d at adjustable speed • Every event links to its source agency report; any view is shareable Free, no app.

records.name: boomation
records.tagline: Your bookmarks. Your browser. Your own cloud.
records.description: Organize bookmarks with workspaces, tags, and notes. Browse in table, board, or card views, and find links fast with quick search. Start locally without an account, or sync directly to your own Google Drive. Your bookmarks never pass through boomation’s servers.

records.name: TaskChef
records.tagline: The missing smart dispatcher and dashboard for Codex tasks
records.description: TaskChef gives Codex desktop one master conversation to delegate work across projects and a dashboard for parallel tasks. Find what needs your input, return to the original chat, track usage, and choose models by role. Free and open source.

records.name: audioglyph.io
records.tagline: The toolkit for the modern electronic music artist.
records.description: The music industry is fragmented. AudioGlyph brings the essential tools for independent electronic music artists into one place from artist analytics and Smart Links to EPKs, riders, artist pages, market analysis, and career organisation. Everything you need to manage and grow your music career, in one place.

records.name: Kanverse ProofStamp
records.tagline: Human-approved AI actions with verifiable receipts
records.description: Kanverse ProofStamp demonstrates bounded AI execution. GPT-6 Astra can inspect state and request an action through WebMCP, but execution stops at an explicit human authorization gate inside Roblox. After approval, Roblox independently gathers live Bitcoin and ISS evidence, creates a machine-readable ProofStamp, and returns an authenticated completion receipt that Astra can verify.

records.name: HushOS Drive
records.tagline: Your files all private
records.description: HushOS Drive keeps your files private without changing how you work. Files, names, and previews are encrypted on your device. Organize with folders and tags, search locally, resume uploads, and preview photos, PDFs, videos, and documents in your browser. Share with people or send links with passwords and expiry dates. Versions and trash help you undo mistakes. Open source and self-hostable, or ready to use at hushos.com with 2 GiB free. Your files, your keys, your choice of where they live.

records.name: Signstamp
records.tagline: Email signatures your whole team can actually use
records.description: Signstamp is a free email signature generator that actually saves your work — something HubSpot's popular tool doesn't do. Build a signature in minutes, no login, no watermark. When you're ready to standardize across a team, upgrade to a paid plan: build one on-brand template, push personalized install links to everyone at once, and skip the back-and-forth with IT. Works with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and Zoho — no Google Workspace admin access required.

records.name: LayerProof Linen
records.tagline: Create UGC videos that convert
records.description: Meet LayerProof Linen: the easiest way to produce high-converting UGC videos. Just upload a product photo and describe your idea. Linen instantly creates an editable script and storyboard, lets you choose your narrator, and generates multiple scenes at once. Save your brand's unique voice, characters, and backdrops as reusable Video Kits for perfect consistency across every channel. Perfect for e-commerce, apps, and local businesses! We make scalable video creation simple for any business.

records.name: Post.buzz
records.tagline: Hire your AI social growth agent
records.description: Grow your brand on social media without spending your day managing it. Post.buzz is your all-in-one AI social media team. It understands your brand voice, images, and videos, then helps create, generate, adapt, publish, engage, and learn across all your socials. AutoDM, Link in Bio.. All batteries included. Create images and videos, schedule posts, manage conversations, and track what works, all in one place. AI First. One system. All your socials. Everything included.

records.name: ClicData MCP
records.tagline: Chat with your company data inside Claude, ChatGPT and more
records.description: ClicData MCP Server: bring your BI data into any AI chat. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other MCP-compatible clients directly to ClicData. Ask any questions on live data, and pull dashboards without leaving the conversation. Phase one covers data & dashboard retrieval; next up: letting your AI client build dashboards and Data Flows on its own. No exports, no new pipelines, just your data, where you're already working!

records.name: VT Code
records.tagline: Open-source coding agent harness built for long-running work
records.description: VT Code turns GPT-6 Astra into a coding agent for long-running software tasks. Its Rust-based harness manages tools, context, sandboxing, permissions, planning, and verification so Astra can work through complex multi-step changes in a controlled, reviewable way. VT Code also supports durable sessions, local models, 31 providers, and open protocols like MCP and ACP.

records.name: ThreeJS Generator
records.tagline: Generate modular ThreeJS assets with one-click GLB exports.
records.description: Most text-to-3D generators are focused on single mesh generation, which can be difficult to edit post-generation. While less suitable for character or creature assets, the ThreeJS Generator is particularly useful for creating architectural or prop assets, with modular, animated, or procedural elements. As an open source tool not gated by paid subscriptions or opaque credit systems, anyone can generate editable 3D assets, with generation costs paid directly to providers using their own API keys.

records.name: Loklyo
records.tagline: A personal radar for opportunities that fit you
records.description: Set your needs, resources, location, and availability once. Loklyo monitors supported public sources and private, consent-based matches, then tells you what changed, why it fits, and what to do next.

records.name: Catcha Play
records.tagline: Draw in 32×32 pixels. Can the AI guess your word?
records.description: Pictionary where the guesser is an AI. You get a word, draw it on a 32×32 pixel grid, and the AI tries to guess it — no letters allowed (an OCR referee blocks cheaters). Pick your guesser from Rookie to Master tier: smarter models guess better but cost more credits. Lose hearts on misses, climb the leaderboard, and try guessing other players' drawings in the gallery. Free in the browser, no install, play as a guest — or plug in your own OpenAI/Anthropic/Google key.

records.name: New Balance Safety Shoes
records.tagline: New Balance Safety Shoes
records.description: Find the best New Balance safety shoes for 2026. Real prices, all models compared, job-specific picks, and sizing tips in one complete guide.

records.name: SELP
records.tagline: Educational symptom checks through an interactive body map
records.description: SELP is a self-guided pain check. Mark where it hurts on a body map, answer a few questions, get an educational report on likely patterns and when to seek care.

records.name: Evidence Trail
records.tagline: Compare quotes. Spot missing details. Keep the proof.
records.description: Compare documents side by side, record each claim with its location and limits, and see which quote details still need answers. Export a readable comparison and a reusable working file. Runs in your browser, without accounts or an AI API key.

records.name: Auspex
records.tagline: Intuitive, Simple Stock Analysis
records.description: Simple US stock analysis for beginners. Clear 0-100 scores on S&P 500 companies, in-app tooltips explain every term, plus free learn guides. Pro tools when you want to go deeper.

records.name: Guild Manager
records.tagline: Run your guild in one place, inside Discord
records.description: Replace the bots and spreadsheets your guild runs on. Roster, events, attendance, loot and analytics in one app, with two-way Discord role sync, DKP auctions and voice attendance. Each game gets its own setup. Free for guilds of any size. 4,065+ guilds.

records.name: Voiceavel
records.tagline: Speak prompts and messages into your Mac apps
records.description: Speak your next detailed prompt, message, or note directly into your Mac apps. Hold your shortcut, speak, and release. Try all features free for 3 days, with 30 total real-time minutes. Start with a prompt you would normally shorten rather than type in full. records.description: nostrfy is an all-in-one Nostr relay server engine written in Rust. Spec-complete, built to never go down, and configurable entirely from nostrfy.toml.

records.name: Finavit
records.tagline: The AI health assistant that knows what it's talking about
records.description: Finavit is an AI-powered health assistant with meal suggestions, a body map, a nutrition database, and an AI chat for guidance. Built solo, from scratch, by an 18-year-old founder in Morocco.

records.name: voisync-lite
records.tagline: Turn 4 Hours Into 5 Minutes
records.description: Transcribe hours of audio to text in minutes. VoiSync Lite uses real-time speech-to-text AI to convert voice recordings into searchable transcripts. Try free for 7 days. No credit card required.

records.name: Float It: Text & Window PiP
records.tagline: Float any text into an always-on-top window
records.description: Float It lets you select any text on any page and pop it into a small always-on-top window - perfect for keeping a recipe, doc, or reference note visible while you cook, code, or write in something else. Free: 50 saved snippets, notes, search, basic customization. Pro ($9/yr or $19 once): unlimited snippets, tags and pins, five reading themes, read-aloud, backup/restore. Built solo, still small, and looking for real feedback.

records.name: Airbnb/Short-Term Rental Profitability
records.tagline: Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Profitability Calculator
records.description: Is your short-term rental actually making you money, or does it just look like it? This calculator shows your real monthly profit in seconds: enter your nightly rate, occupancy, platform fees, cleaning costs, and fixed expenses, and instantly see what's actually left in your pocket.

records.name: FX Converter
records.tagline: Add up many currencies at once, 55 years of rate history
records.description: Free multi-currency converter: add USD, EUR, JPY and 140+ currencies into one total at live mid-market rates. 62 pair pages with daily history back to 1971, year and month archives, a calendar-month seasonality table, CSV export, an embeddable rate card and an API. No sign-up.

records.name: Swarm
records.tagline: Spaces Where Humans and Agents Work Together
records.description: I've been working on Swarm since March exclusively with OpenAI's models and I always use their latest releases for the core of development. Swarm allows for the creation of Spaces where agents/humans can collaborate and store persisted data/memory in Decision Graphs. Swarm is model agnostic and supports both local runtimes and cloud hosted agents. You can also connected cross Space agents giving Swarm a network and essentially providing an intelligence substrate for agents.

records.name: The Other Side
records.tagline: A real-time co-op game where Astra is Player Two.
records.description: The Other Side is a real-time co-op escape game where GPT-6 Astra is your second player. You explore the physical spacecraft while Astra investigates manuals, logs, diagnostics, and remote systems. Neither side has the full picture. Find evidence, steer Astra while it is already working, and combine human observation with Astra’s digital capabilities to escape together.

records.name: SwimNow
records.tagline: By your side, for every swim and every little victory
records.description: SwimNow is a companion for your swimming journey. It turns your swim data into insights that help you see your progress and find the motivation to return to the water. Whether you're chasing a personal best or simply making time for yourself, every swim is worth celebrating. Every little victory is yours.

records.name: Horizon PM
records.tagline: Open-source desktop product manager
records.description: Horizon PM is an offline-first, cryptographic, multi-cloud product management platform for teams and individuals. Plan, track, release, and ship products with confidence — AES-256 vault, Kanban, UAT gates, and 5 cloud backends.

records.name: Practical Magic 2
records.tagline: Practical Magic 2 is a fan-focused guide for movie lovers.
records.description: Practical Magic 2 is a fan-focused guide for movie lovers who want an easy place to explore information about the upcoming sequel. The site brings together useful details about Practical Magic 2, including the release date, cast, trailer information, story details, characters, and other movie-related updates. A fan-focused guide to Practical Magic 2 with cast details, release information, trailer updates, story information, and more.

records.name: Evidra — The research harness
records.tagline: Give your agents a problem worth staying with.
records.description: Evidra gives research agents durable memory, parallel exploration, and experimental rigor. Independent agent lanes investigate competing ideas and share discoveries. Failed hypotheses inform future attempts, evidence stays linked to its sources, and replication gates check promising results. Adaptive recovery changes approach after failures, while checkpoints let campaigns resume across sessions. One harness for open-ended research and measurable challenges.

records.name: Mini préstamos
records.tagline: Contrata ahora
records.description: Autorizar un préstamo es un acto de gran responsabilidad. Cuando la respuesta es positiva, la satisfacción es enorme, ya que sé que estoy impulsando el bienestar de una familia o el inicio de un nuevo proyecto.

records.name: SlickCatalog — Free browser
records.tagline: Bulk product-catalog tools that never leave your browser
records.description: 👋 Hey PH! I built SlickCatalog because I was tired of uploading product photos/CSVs to random tools just to convert them. Everything runs 100% in your browser (Web Workers, no server, no account): 🖼️ Bulk WebP converter 🔄 Shopify↔WooCommerce CSV converter 💰 Supplier price list matcher 🧹 Variant name cleaner 🔢 Barcode/SKU tools

records.name: StayMission
records.tagline: Property operations and owner updates, in one place
records.description: StayMission is a property-operations platform built for property managers, their teams and owners. Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, inspections and everyday tasks from one organized workspace. Assign responsibilities, track progress, use checklists, store photo evidence and maintain a clear history for every property. Managers control what gets shared, while owners receive approved updates and reports through a private portal. StayMission is available as a free pilot with no card required.

records.name: Krafto AI: Chat to Edit Videos
records.tagline: Turn raw footage into polished videos just by chatting
records.description: Editing talking-head videos takes hours of tedious cutting and framing. Krafto AI changes that by letting you edit raw footage through chat. Upload your clip and tell it what to do: remove silences, add zooms, or generate captions. No complex timeline tools needed. You get studio-ready videos in minutes simply by talking to AI.

records.name: Hangman Now
records.tagline: Classic Hangman cast to your TV via AirPlay
records.description: Hangman Now brings the classic word-guessing game to the living room. Your iPhone or iPad becomes the secret controller while an AirPlay-connected TV or Mac displays the gallows and mystery word for everyone to see. It comes with a massive word library across categories like Movies and Science, plus custom difficulty so you can match word length and category to your group's skill level. No ads, no accounts, no data tracking, no subscription.

records.name: Slate
records.tagline: AI workspace that reads the whole project in memory
records.description: Other AI tools read fragments of your knowledge. Slate reads all of it, up to 750,000 words or 500 images, per query ( up to 1 million tokens context on supported models) from your project space. And reasons using the full context. Slate also lets you make live edits to your knowledge/documents with the AI immediately picking up the changed context in the next query.

records.name: AI Skills Assessment
records.tagline: Free AI literacy tests with feedback and certificates
records.description: AI Skills Assessment is a free Japanese-language platform for measuring and improving practical AI literacy. Choose from six exams covering fundamentals, AI agents, workplace adoption, risk management, vibe coding, and productivity. Get instant scores and explanations, retake any exam for free, and download a certificate when you pass. More than 25,000 learners have already used the service. ASK Learning adds short videos and mini quizzes for continuous learning.

records.name: AEO Digital
records.tagline: Building AI Search Visibility That Keeps Your Brand Ahead
records.description: A next-generation AI Search Visibility platform built to help brands get discovered, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search engines. Leverage GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) to track your brand visibility, monitor competitors, uncover content opportunities, and optimize how AI engines understand and surface your brand. Turn AI search into a measurable growth channel and stay ahead as search evolves beyond traditional SEO.

records.name: Folveta
records.tagline: Source-grounded study guides from course files
records.description: Folveta turns readable course PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and image materials into a structured Study Guide with priorities, key concepts, definitions, source references, and visible gaps. Students can optionally create a five-question Quick Check and return to the guide for review. The demo uses synthetic Biology material. Folveta is designed for study and review; it does not replace instructors or guarantee learning outcomes.

records.name: Truffle Journal
records.tagline: iPhone notes that ChatGPT can save, read, and update
records.description: Ask ChatGPT to save an answer as an editable Markdown note on your iPhone. No copy-paste. Add your own thoughts, edit tables and set reminders. Later, ask ChatGPT to read or update that same note. Connect once in about 2 minutes with a guided 3-step tutorial, and receive one month of Truffle Plus free when you finish.

records.name: GitHub
records.tagline: to support myself during the finding the new job easily
records.description: This project focuses on building AI chatbot with RAG about latest LinkedIn job (the last updated: 23/4/2025). This project is built by MNT team, University of Science, in major Mathematics and Computer Science - hangtantai/linkedin-chatbot-job

records.name: WhatsApp Business Cloud API Automation
records.tagline: WhatsApp Business
records.description: Connect your applications to WhatsApp effortlessly using this high-performance Apify Actor powered by the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Perfect for e-commerce notifications, transactional alerts, multi-channel marketing campaigns, and customer support workflows.

records.name: Lens
records.tagline: Mac screen recorder that adds the zoom for you
records.description: Record your screen and Lens adds automatic zoom, smooth cursor movement and on-device captions. Make product demos and tutorials people can follow. Everything is edited on your Mac. Paid plans add shareable links. 7-day free trial, no account or card.

records.name: TopShelf
records.tagline: Pin apps & websites to your menu bar
records.description: PIN MAC APPS: Pick any app from your Applications folder. PIN WEBSITES: Drop in a URL, or right-click any link and choose "Pin URL to TopShelf." BUILT-IN MINI APPS: Snippets, Notes, Calculator, Pomodoro, Color Picker, Password Generator KEYBOARD-FIRST: Assign a global hotkey to any pin. WORKS WITH SELF-HOSTED: Localhost sites. FLOATS OVER FULLSCREEN EXPORT & BACKUP: Save your Mini App data to a single JSON file from Settings.

records.name: Lahjty
records.tagline: Complete Arabic Marketing Team
records.description: Create Arabic ad copy, campaign images, voice ads, and SEO articles in Saudi, Gulf, Egyptian, and Levantine dialects with Lahjty, the Arabic marketing platform for MENA.
