Thep source files are compiled intoa artifact files. Artifact files are to be trans-piled into other programming languages like - C programming language - Verilog HDL - CUDA C so, "A" is a programming language for all programs.

records.name: Backs
records.tagline: A playful new tab dashboard you can make your own
records.description: Turn your Chrome new tab into a space that feels like you. Arrange tasks, notes, bookmarks and playful widgets that match your wallpaper. Create Spaces for work or downtime, then share your setup with a link. Free to start, with no account needed.

records.name: Attendance Management System
records.tagline: Simple attendance & shift management for small businesses.
records.description: This is a simple attendance and shift management system designed for small businesses. It helps teams manage employee attendance, work schedules, and shifts without the complexity of traditional workforce management software. The system supports Chinese, English, and Japanese, making it suitable for multilingual workplaces.

records.name: Alcorone
records.tagline: AlcorOne Solutions — Interior Contracting, South Inda
records.description: Interior contracting across South India. Residential office and retail fit-outs from our Chennai head ofice, plus Hyderabad, Vizag and Rajahmundry.

records.name: Spellcast
records.tagline: Desktop stage for coding agents: bubbles & Canvas
records.description: Spellcast was built with GPT-6 Astra. I used Astra heavily to design and ship the desktop stage: passive bubbles for side thoughts, an editable Canvas for results, and completion notices when a turn ends. That burned through my Astra Pro 20x before launch day. Runtime target today: Codex on Windows (MCP + hooks). Local-first, open source, EN/中文 UI. The clip shows one host path; the core idea is the desktop stage around the agent.

records.name: Offboarding Transfer Utility
records.tagline: Transfer Jira ownership when employees leave
records.description: Handle employee handovers in Jira Cloud. Find a departing user’s filters, dashboards, project and component ownership, and open assigned issues. Review the results, transfer them to a successor, and keep an audit history. Built on Atlassian Forge. Free for sites with up to 10 users.

records.name: Tegeera
records.tagline: Speak it. See it. Understand it.
records.description: Tegeera draws while you're still explaining live, not a single AI image after the fact. Speech becomes structured meaning, then DoodleScript, validated before anything renders: same explanation, same result, every time, and it pauses to ask rather than confidently drawing the wrong thing. Offline-first, typed fallback, built accessibility-first. No competitor combines real-time deterministic drawing with honest uncertainty — most fake confidence; Tegeera doesn't.

records.name: GPSRPilot
records.tagline: Automate EU GPSR compliance dossiers & labels in 10 mins
records.description: Traditional compliance agencies charge €1,500+ per product and take weeks. Generic AI tools fail Amazon audits. GPSRPilot automates EU GPSR (2023/988) compliance in 10 mins: • All 5 mandatory technical files (Risk Assessment, DoC, Traceability) • 300 DPI print-ready label studio with CE marks & localized warnings • Formatted to clear Amazon Account Health warnings • Auto-embeds designated EU Responsible Person details From $19/mo with a free tier. Built for Amazon, Etsy & Shopify sellers.

records.name: EMORAPY
records.tagline: AI that gets to know you both—to help you hear each other
records.description: What you mean isn't always what your partner hears. EMORAPY helps couples reflect individually, choose what to share, and work through misunderstandings with AI mediation. Turn understanding into shared agreements, relationship-repair activities and follow-up check-ins. As you use it, the AI builds a deeper understanding of both your backgrounds, personalities and values, making its guidance more relevant to you both. Not therapy.

records.name: MarkReply - Privacy-First Comments
records.tagline: Drop-in comments without the bloat. Powered by Rust & HTMX
records.description: A blazingly fast, privacy-first commenting engine powered by Rust and HTMX. Self-host it for free, or let us manage the multi-tenant infrastructure for you.

records.name: Certs Hero
records.tagline: Web Based Practice Test Engine
records.description: CertsHero is an unfunded company based in New York City (United States), founded in 2022. It operates as a platform that offers realistic exam questions, practice tests, and study materials for multiple certification exams across IT, cloud, cybersecurity, SAP, and project management domains. CertsHero has not raised any funding yet. The company has 141 active competitors, including 2 funded and 3 that have exited.

records.name: Anonymous Swap
records.tagline: Swap that doesnt freeze your funds
records.description: No KYC, No logs. Instant anonymous crypto swaps.

records.name: Habify
records.tagline: AI-powered food logging for effortless nutrition tracking
records.description: Habify is a smart calorie tracker that makes nutrition tracking quick, accurate, and effortless. Log meals in seconds with AI by taking a photo, scanning a barcode, or typing a description. Track calories, protein, macros, sugar, fiber, and more. Set personalized goals, track your progress, get guidance from your coach Mira, and stay motivated with friends. No more friction—just simple, sustainable habits.

records.name: You're up!
records.tagline: Share live, adoptable run of shows for event planners
records.description: Most run of show tools end at a PDF. You're up! is one live link: change a time and every device using it updates. No login, no app. Anyone with the link can adopt it and add their own private items on top (load-in, mic check, speech notes), anchored to the shared rows so they move when the schedule slips. Their layer stays on their device, so one link works for the AV team, the caterer and the MC. Free to use forevever. Calendar, Who and Branding are in paid.

records.name: Astra Scientist
records.tagline: Ten measurements to test your scientific explanation
records.description: A virtual cold-atom lab with a ten-measurement budget. Choose experiments in your browser, inspect noisy synthetic evidence and record a conclusion you can trace to data. Built with Astra; experiment choices are manual or rule-based.

records.name: PaySovra
records.tagline: Sell your products and services, get paid in crypto
records.description: Non-custodial crypto and stablecoin payment gateway. Sell your products and services, get paid in crypto and stable coins. Integrate with your existing website, or use our hosted product pages and invoices. Payments are settled straight to the wallets you control. We never hold or manage your funds. Integrates with your local AI Agent to manage your store.

records.name: FreeEditTools
records.tagline: 40+ free, fast browser tools for video, audio, image & text
records.description: FreeEditTools is a collection of 40+ free video, audio & media tools that work directly in your browser. Compress videos for Discord & email, resize for Instagram & YouTube, convert formats, create GIFs, grab thumbnails, extract audio & frames, remove metadata, and more. Fast, simple, no sign-in, no software to install, no subscription. Just pick a tool, drop your file, and get it done.

records.name: BDB × GPT-6 Astra
records.tagline: Astra proposes. Humans approve. BDB proves.
records.description: GPT-6 Astra analyzes a bounded synthetic repository, finds a genuine concurrency defect, and proposes an exact two-file fix — but it cannot execute it. A human approves one SHA-256 fingerprint. BDB then verifies the approved bytes, materializes only that change, and runs fixed test + build checks in an isolated container with no network or secrets. The result is published as sanitized, inspectable proof.

records.name: Bench
records.tagline: Your AI agent edits video. You stay creative.
records.description: Bench is a native Mac video editor built for AI agents through MCP. Finally models are capable of doing the grunt work of sliders and button pressing. Now you can focus on the creativity. Built the ground up for agent gets precise editing tools, this is an agent first editor. Local rendering using fast swift and metal frameworks allows for NLE class colour adjustments, video formats, framing and audio fades and more. Finish in Bench or export to Final Cut or Resolve.

records.name: PixBox — Photo File Manager
records.tagline: Batch-select, dedupe and organize photos like Finder on Mac
records.description: PixBox treats your photo library like a file system. Batch-select, organize, dedupe, compress, zip, and share photos & videos like files on your computer. One-time purchase — no subscription, no ads, on-device.

records.name: VidBook
records.tagline: The market-led book publishing studio
records.description: VidBook is an AI publishing studio that turns long-form YouTube transcripts into editable manuscripts, paperback-layout PDFs, EPUB files and DOCX files for human review.

records.name: ONO
records.tagline: From Oh No! to meaningful moments
records.description: ONO is a voice-first leadership coach that helps managers prepare for meaningful workplace conversations. Talk through challenges, practise difficult discussions through roleplay, and understand different communication styles with DISC-informed insights. An expressive orb brings warmth to the experience through colour, movement and a gentle glow. (App store version is in review)

records.name: FinderBack
records.tagline: Back & Forward navigation in Finder’s right-click menu
records.description: FinderBack is a small macOS utility that adds Back and Forward navigation directly to Finder’s right-click menu. I built it because I wanted faster folder navigation without constantly moving back to Finder’s toolbar. The source is available on GitHub, and there’s also a ready-to-run download for $9.99.

records.name: ReviewWithAI
records.tagline: Work with Infinite AI Context. Take decision beyond the chat
records.description: Your best thinking shouldn't disappear when an AI chat ends. Review Markdown plans, research and specs, leave feedback on exact passages, and use comment IDs to direct your next agent session. Keep decisions and open questions in project files you can revisit. Try the free sample demo: no sign-in, project upload or AI API key. Demo comments are temporary; agents run outside the demo. Built with GPT-6 Astra. Public self-hosted release planned.

records.name: Which Draft
records.tagline: Compare AI-written sales messages, side by side
records.description: Compare AI-written sales messages using the same context. Switch models, test different skills, or vote on the better message in Battle. Try examples free without an account; bring your own API key to write new messages.

records.name: Kodro
records.tagline: Kids can code robots. Astra debugs. Evidence decides.
records.description: Kodro is an offline robot studio for UK Computing, KS1 to KS4. Pupils design a rover, write real code, and run it through simulated worlds, getting pass/fail evidence with telemetry on every run. NEW: Genesis races up to 4 controllers through seeded contracts and proves the winner. Built for reasoning agents: Astra can drive the full loop over MCP, reading code, running it, grading it, iterating, while Kodro holds verdicts no model can fake. Honest kinematic sim, MIT open source.

records.name: TikViewer
records.tagline: Watch TikTok stories anonymously, no login needed
records.description: Free anonymous TikTok story viewer. Enter a username to watch stories anonymously and save them before the 24-hour window closes. No login, no app, nothing to install.

records.name: Markify
records.tagline: Zero-install, zero-build modern documentation engine
records.description: Markify turns raw Markdown files into a modern, glassmorphic documentation site instantly in the browser. Zero Node.js, zero build steps, and zero dependencies required. It fetches raw Markdown dynamically and features instant client-side FlexSearch (Cmd+K), light/dark mode support, dynamic Table of Contents, code highlighting, and one-click snippet copying out of the box.

records.name: Just Catching Up
records.tagline: A private place for your people. No ads. No addictive feeds.
records.description: Keep up with friends and family without the noise. Share posts, photos and videos with mutual connections or invitation-only spaces. Read everything in order, reach the end, and get on with your day. No ads, public profiles, ranked feeds or strangers. Try it free for 3 days, no card needed. Personal and Family plans offer monthly or yearly billing, with 12 months for the price of 10.

records.name: Yingma
records.tagline: Create AI dramas and interactive story games
records.description: Yingma is an AI creation workspace for short dramas and interactive story games. Develop scripts, characters, storyboards, and video scenes. Build branching stories with multiple endings, item- and stat-based choices, panoramic exploration, and timed interactions. Playtest your story and export a playable package. Choose a guided Agent pipeline, an infinite canvas, or a dedicated interactive story editor. 小影马是AI短剧制作平台。从剧本、角色、分镜、画面到配音字幕，五步出片，让零基础创作者也能完成可发布、可连载的动态短剧。

records.name: Drawing Arena
records.tagline: You draw. AIs race to guess in real time.
records.description: Drawing Arena turns a 60-second sketch into a live AI race. You get a secret word, draw it, and independent AI models try to identify your picture every five seconds—without seeing each other’s answers. Mystery matchups keep model identities hidden until the reveal, and every finished race can become a replay challenge for friends. It’s a game first, but also a fun way to see how differently vision models interpret the same drawing.

records.name: Vero: AI Health Assistant
records.tagline: Understand Your Lab Results
records.description: Meet Vero — your AI health assistant. Vero sees your whole health picture: Apple Health data, lab results, medications, allergies, conditions, and family history. Ask anything and get a clear answer in plain language — in the context of your actual health data, with sources you can check. No more re-explaining yourself to a chatbot that forgets you.

records.name: SQLBraid
records.tagline: Write SQL. Keep TypeScript. Skip the query builder.
records.description: SQLBraid is a SQL-first data-access toolkit for TypeScript. Write ordinary SQL with safe binds, typed results, dynamic SQL, transactions, streaming, and codegen—without translating queries into a query-builder DSL.

records.name: Pump Housing
records.tagline: Stainless Steel Pump Housing
records.description: JC Casting manufactures custom stainless steel pump housings using investment casting, sand casting and CNC machining for industrial pump applications.

records.name: Cogenius
records.tagline: Pitch decks & brand visuals that help startups close deals
records.description: CoGenius is a creative boutique agency based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, serving founders and businesses across the US and Europe. We craft investor-ready pitch decks, conversion-focused websites, company profiles, and brand visuals designed to help you win the room, not just look good in it. From first pitch to full brand identity, our team turns your story into visuals that move stakeholders to say yes. 100+ clients, dozens of countries, one focus: design that drives outcomes.

records.name: Baseball Physics Lab
records.tagline: Change the contact. Explore the flight in 3D.
records.description: Explore how a bat meets a ball in a physics-based 3D lab. Adjust bat angle, impact point, speed, mass and incoming spin, then compare exit speed, launch angle, spin and flight. Pin A, change a setting and compute B. Compare drag and spin-induced lift, drag only, or vacuum flight, and explore weather effects. Free in your browser and on Windows, with seven languages and flexible units. Built with Astra's help. Model-based estimates, not validated real-world predictions.

records.name: Noviora
records.tagline: Turn your real life into an RPG.
records.description: Noviora is an educational real-life RPG that turns useful everyday actions into quests and meaningful progress. Choose your path — Magic, Strength, or Alchemy — complete real-world quests, earn XP, collect Codex cards, discover recipes, and share progress with friends and guilds. Adventure Map covers supported city routes only, not the whole world. Every useful action feels like part of an adventure.

records.name: Tailerd
records.tagline: Find second-hand fashion below estimated market price
records.description: Tailerd is an independent search and comparison service from Gothenburg (UF student company). It aggregates listings from Plick, Vinted, Sellpy and Tradera, highlights deals under estimated market price, and is building 24h reserve then pay in local stores. We do not sell inventory ourselves — purchase happens on the source platforms.

records.name: Compass Plus
records.tagline: Improves compass with a single chrome extension.
records.description: Customize Compass with themes, live/static wallpapers, better navigation, a cleaner timetable, shortcuts, and QOL tools.

records.name: Carryo
records.tagline: Publish websites from your AI chat
records.description: Carryo is the easiest (non developer) way to publish websites with your AI agent. Create and update sites in ChatGPT, Claude and other AI chats. Keep the same live link as you make changes and see your edit history. Collaborate with your team on shared Carryo sites.

records.name: xVRAM Developer Preview
records.tagline: Run supported CUDA workloads beyond physical VRAM
records.description: An experimental open-source CUDA SDK with RAM backing and a bounded VRAM cache. The recorded RTX 3070 demo processes 11.999 GiB of matrix data on an 8 GiB GPU. Includes a Windows build, C API example and local validation. Explicit integration required.

records.name: The ClubHouse
records.tagline: Strava for Tennis, Play, Plan, Share, Meet, Organize, Coach
records.description: Teasing phase manage to reach +1500 users before launch Feature : - king of the court (=Strava KOM for Tennis on each court of the planet, with a ranking based on the most vaillant victories) - Share your result like a pro, a social media dedicated feature to share your game results with AO, US open, Rolad Garros, Wimbledon style, and many more..

records.name: Fix Laptop Sluggishness
records.tagline: Quick tips to speed up your workflow
records.description: A practical guide for diagnosing and fixing a slow laptop. It covers common causes of sluggish performance and actionable steps to improve speed, responsiveness, startup time, storage, and overall workflow efficiency.

records.name: Hakimo
records.tagline: Give Your Security System Superpowers
records.description: Hakimo is an AI software platform that provides virtual remote guarding & security monitoring, working with surveillance cameras to reduce vandalism, theft, physical threats and unauthorized access

records.name: Archbro
records.tagline: Turn complex codebases into shared, actionable architecture
records.description: Archbro turns complex codebases into living architecture that humans and AI can understand and act on. Explore project purpose, components, interactions, journeys, code evidence, and related tasks in one workspace. Collaborate through Owner, Editor, and Viewer roles, enforce task prerequisites, and review architecture proposals before they become the team's accepted version. This release was built and refined with GPT‑6 Astra.

records.name: Alex Adventures
records.tagline: An illustrated offline adventure, made for my son
records.description: A challenging illustrated offline iPhone platformer built with GPT-6 Astra, with a hero inspired by a photo of my son. Explore 20 worlds, dodge enemy fire and face individual bosses. Hardcore gives you just three health points. Think you can finish it? Free, with no ads or in-app purchases. Custom characters from photos are in experimental development.

records.name: Based Developer Tools
records.tagline: EverydayDev — Free developer
records.description: Free, fast developer utilities that run entirely in your browser. Nothing you paste is ever uploaded.

records.name: Chat_AI: Recipe Lab
records.tagline: Discover meals you’ll love, without the recipe hunt
records.description: Recipe Lab helps you discover meals you’ll actually want to cook without searching through recipes yourself. Instead of giving you one finished answer, it lets you explore several directions, choose one you like, and refine it through conversation. Save only the recipes you’re happy with, then use post-cook feedback to build a TasteProfile that improves future suggestions.

records.name: Health Assistant
records.tagline: Personal preventive health copilot

records.description: AimiRun is a free AI running coach. Set a goal, follow a plan, get voice guidance on every run, and know what to do next. Plan, run, and review in one app: goal-based workouts (5K–marathon), live pace/cadence voice cues, GPS tracking, and practical post-run review. Free on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Snappit
records.tagline: Identify any animal and collect it as a Pokemon card
records.description: Snap a photo to identify plants, animals, birds, and bugs. A free, kid-safe nature app for families — collect discoveries and turn every walk into an adventure.

records.name: Tomok
records.tagline: AI Agents for Heavy Civil Project Control
records.description: Tomok is an AI-native workspace for heavy civil construction projects.

records.name: ANWIN
records.tagline: Automates software engineering with secure governance.
records.description: Anwin is an Enterprise AI Engineering Platform built for organizations that need engineering acceleration without losing control of their code. Unlike editor-only assistants, Anwin runs inside the customer’s cloud or data center, understands the entire repository, traces real security risks, maps findings to compliance frameworks, and provides role-based governance with full auditability. Private, governed, and built for enterprise-scale software engineering.

records.name: Wotbox
records.tagline: Your own space for people, apps and AI agents
records.description: Wotbox is a self-hosted desktop for you, your connections and your AI agents. Chat, share files and customize your dashBox on a server you control. Apps have separate interfaces for people and authorized agents, with permissions you choose. Keep your workspace private and use your public wall to share what you want. Built for people who want more control over how they connect, create and use AI. Available now in beta.

records.name: NewRouters
records.tagline: Language, image, and video APIs for developers
records.description: NewRouters gives developers API access to language, image, and video models. Explore model-specific inputs, protocols, and pricing in public catalogs, then integrate using the API documentation. Includes API key, billing, and request management.

records.name: Family Folio
records.tagline: Keep your family's recipes close
records.description: Keep handwritten pages and photos beside clear ingredients and instructions. Organize recipes in folders and share individual recipes or folders through iCloud. A native iPhone app, built for my family and yours.

records.name: RoboRat Studio™
records.tagline: Verify claims and turn them into production-ready shorts
records.description: RoboRat Studio™ is an evidence-first AI studio for short-form creators. FactLab™ uses GPT-6 Astra to research and verify a claim, surface sources, and preserve important caveats before anything is written. It then scores the story, builds an 8–10 second script, plans each shot, packages platform copy, and runs a final evidence audit on every factual spoken claim. Link to Video Demo: https://youtu.be/Q8VNymcgyus

records.name: TiviMate Prime
records.tagline: tivimateprime
records.description: Access 34,000+ live channels & 195,000+ movies & series with a premium IPTV UK service. Built-in VPN protection, no contracts & instant activation.

records.name: Where Was I?
records.tagline: Pause your work. Pick up where you left off
records.description: Where Was I? doesn’t just remember which apps were open. It captures the full context of your work, including browser tabs, screenshots, notes, window positions, project status, and your next step. Everything stays local on your Mac, so you can return hours or days later and quickly understand exactly where you left off.

records.name: Climate Change 3d Experience
records.tagline: Your Climate Change 3d Experience.
records.description: an AI powered climate tutor with a guided 3D experience that helps people see how climate change connects oceans, wildlife, coral reefs, ice and coastal communitiesExplore warming oceans, migrating wildlife, coral bleaching and rising seas in a guided 3D journey. Nimbus explains each scene with device narration, simple lessons and quizzes. Built with GPT-6 Astra.

records.name: Stellogram
records.tagline: Social media where your privacy actually comes first.
records.description: Stellogram is a privacy-first social platform built for authentic connection without surveillance. We believe social media shouldn't come at the cost of your personal data. Experience lightning-fast discovery, direct community sharing, and clean feeds—completely free from intrusive tracking, predatory algorithms, or invasive data harvesting. Your data stays yours, always.

records.name: Lebirun
records.tagline: A hobby operating system
records.description: A hobby operating system that i've made to be quite light. Maybe not the lightest but also made to work with modern software.

records.name: Rhythm Cycle™
records.tagline: AI Coach to help users win goals with optimized daily living
records.description: Rhythm Cycle™ helps the user achieve success with their holistic goals from morning routines, running work or study sprints, fitness & nutrition, recovery, to a restful sleep, that stems from a proprietary The 8 Daily Rhythms™ system, where users win goals just by living a sustainable and highly optimized daily life.

records.name: OffLadder
records.tagline: Don't pick your future. Test it.
records.description: OffLadder is free career exploration for people who want to test directions through short, real-world experiments—not a personality quiz. It turns interests and constraints into one thing to try today, then helps you learn from it.

records.name: NEXO Privilege Gate
records.tagline: A least-privilege security gateway for AI agents
records.description: NEXO Privilege Gate v0.4.0 is an open-source least-privilege gateway for AI agents. It now enforces structured filesystem actions inside a local sandbox, blocks path escapes and sensitive-file aliases, requires human approval for destructive actions, quarantines deletions, and records a tamper-evident audit trail. GPT-6 Astra also found and helped fix a real path-alias authorization bypass before release.

records.name: Lecut Construction
records.tagline: Design, Build & Transform Your Home
records.description: LeCut Construction combines design, planning, and construction to transform homes from concept to completion. Services include kitchen and bathroom remodeling, whole-home renovations, ADUs, room and second-story additions, garage conversions, luxury home construction, landscaping, and hardscaping. Its design-build approach keeps planning, project management, and construction coordinated under one team.

records.name: Trading Market Grid
records.tagline: A live multi-market grid built for faster chart decisions
records.description: Trading Market Grid puts stocks, crypto, gold and volatility into one focused live workspace. Compare 30-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour and daily charts, create price alerts directly from a chart, spot EMA 12/21 crosses through six-hour visual highlights, and hear market-open and market-close cues. Choose from 200+ assets without jumping between tabs.

records.name: Real or Fake?
records.tagline: A second opinion on the internet’s questionable claims
records.description: The internet says a lot of things. Real or Fake? gives questionable posts, messages and screenshots a second look, checking 21 signals from scam tactics to satire. Open Jev’s read to see what the bird picked up.

records.name: 切磨工作台 · Facet 96
records.tagline: Gemstone Faceting, Design, Computer-Aided Design
records.description: This is an AI-powered gemstone faceting design tool that includes a cutting assistant and optical simulation, and is open-source.

records.name: Sentinel Cyber AI Workplace
records.tagline: Find Risk. Stop Threats. Secure Every Repository.
records.description: Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity workplace that scans local and Github repositories for vulnerabilities, secrets, supply-chain risks, prompt injection, and other security issues, with build-int threat modeling, AI red teaming, CVE intelligence, and a Security Copilot.

records.name: OWEN Podcast Studio
records.tagline: Turn English podcasts into Chinese, locally
records.description: OWEN 中文播客节目库，支持移动端Turn English podcasts into Chinese audio on your Windows PC. OWEN Podcast Studio combines RSS import, transcription, speaker-aware translation, multi-voice narration, audio checks and mastering. Process episodes in batches, reuse completed work and publish to a mobile-friendly listening library. Developed with GPT-6 Astra; speech recognition, translation and narration run on local models.播放与断点续播。

records.name: XHelpers Pro
records.tagline: 60+ Mac tools. One menu bar.
records.description: XHelpers Pro puts 60+ everyday Mac tools in one menu bar. Snap windows and restore their positions, control displays, boost each app's volume up to 200%, remap keys and mouse buttons, grab text from your screen, and protect files in encrypted Safes. Finder actions, PDF tools and Mac health checks are built in, with 67 actions you can bind to global shortcuts. For Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14+. Limited-time offer: 100% off a lifetime license. Yours forever once claimed.

records.name: Design Arc
records.tagline: Evidence-backed product journeys before you build
records.description: Design Arc is a Codex plugin that turns vague product feedback into a complete, evidence-backed design direction. It confirms the outcome, audits the real user journey, checks decisions against official platform guidance and optional Mobbin benchmarks, recommends the strongest path, and designs every important state before implementation. Human approval gates preserve control, while optional Google Stitch exploration helps teams compare and refine visual proposals.

records.name: mAIn Human
records.tagline: Your favorite digital person
records.description: mAIn human is one AI to talk to. It's a 3D digital person on your Windows desktop. The first character is Ed. Two things make it more than a chat buddy: 1. It's the middleman. You talk to Ed; he routes the work to Claude, Codex, GPT and reports back. 2. It's the context layer. mAIn human is wired into your memory, so every task goes out with the context it needs and comes back with what actually happened. Today mAIn human is free to claim. Pricing comes after launch.

records.name: SkiHub
records.tagline: First Autonomous AI & SaaS Ecosystem forGlobal Outdoor Sport
records.description: SkiHub Tech is a SportTech platform built from real-world mountain experience, combining the challenges of extreme outdoor conditions with today’s AI to make sports easier for millions. We’re building a year-round, cashless ecosystem powered by real-time AI Match, smart bookings, and autonomous AI agents for global onboarding.

records.name: Privy Pilot
records.tagline: Read any contract on your iPhone. Nothing leaves the phone.
records.description: Open a lease, NDA, employment or freelance contract on your iPhone. Privy Pilot pulls out the vitals (parties, money, dates, notice periods), flags one-sided clauses in plain English with the exact quote and page number, and answers your questions with citations. When the document doesn't answer, it says so. The AI model runs on the phone's chip via MLX: no server, no account, nothing uploaded. Built by a lawyer for RevenueCat's #Shipaton. Free to download, 3-day trial, pay once.

records.name: Uncharted
records.tagline: Interactive learning for math, programming and system design
records.description: Uncharted is an interactive, gamified learning platform built around learning by doing. Instead of just reading lessons or watching videos, you write and run real code, draw system architectures, visualize math, experiment with concepts, and see ideas come to life without leaving your browser. Every subject gets an experience designed around what you're learning and a context aware AI tutor that guides you when you get stuck without simply giving you the answer.

records.name: StoryTree App
records.tagline: Turn familiar voices into stories kids can replay anytime
records.description: StoryTree helps families turn familiar voices into stories children can return to anytime. Parents and grandparents can record stories in their own voice, write one from scratch, or create a personalized story with AI and have it narrated in a voice the child already knows. Each story is saved in a private family library, giving kids a simple way to replay favorite moments while parents stay in control of what is created, shared, and available for their family.

records.name: TokenNations
records.tagline: A global leaderboard where countries compete on AI usage
records.description: TokenNations turns your AI coding usage into a country vs country leaderboard. Run a local CLI, it reads your existing Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or other tools usage logs and syncs the totals, no code or prompts ever leave your machine. Every token you burn counts toward your country's score, so you're not just building for yourself, you're repping your country.

records.name: DRA Global Solutions LLC
records.tagline: ​AI advisor that turns complexity
records.description: AI advisor for DRA Global Solutions LLC. Provides expert guidance on business consulting, B2B & B2C services, and AI automation. Visit https://draglobalsolutions.com or contact soporte@draglobalsolutions.com

records.name: Flyercat.com
records.tagline: Hyperlocal advertising. Waste less. Sell more. ⚡
records.description: A hyper-local advertising platform for small businesses, enabling digital flyers to be created and triggered based on: weather conditions, major events, calendar items, and business rhythm. Imagine a pharmacy being able to send out digital flyers for nasal sprays when the pollen count is high. A cafe sending out a coffee and cake offer during a quiet rainy afternoon. Our Mantra - waste less, sell more. No junk mail, just for locals. Launching in Surrey first — join the waitlist for your town.

records.name: Compounding: The Startup Game
records.tagline: Scale from humble beginnings to a unicorn valuation.
records.description: StartupSim is a startup management game set in the AI boom. Build products, hire a team, choose models, manage compute and runway, launch into markets, react to competitors and chaos, and grow from a tiny apartment into an AI empire.

records.name: VibeRizz
records.tagline: Dating apps waste your time. Your agent doesn't
records.description: Viberizz gives you an AI agent that represents you — it finds compatible agents, has real conversations with them, evaluates fit, and recommends matches with reasons, not just percentages. You approve every intro. Dating, minus the swiping grind.

records.name: BeamChart
records.tagline: Free steel beam size charts and weight calculator
records.description: Explore steel beam sizes, dimensions, weights, and section properties with BeamChart. Browse AISC W, S, and HP shapes and calculate beam weight by size, length, and quantity. A free reference for engineers, fabricators, and students.

records.name: AndroLLM
records.tagline: Private AI in your pocket — local, cloud, BYOK on Android.
records.description: Open-source Android AI using LiteRT-LM with hardware acceleration, cloud providers, memory, and voice. - ShadowSafin/AndroLLM

records.name: PewHQ
records.tagline: The church back office, joined to the pew
records.description: PewHQ runs a church in one system: people, giving with real fund accounting, groups that talk by email, child check-in, a website, and a member app with a free Bible. Prices are published, and giving fees are passed through at cost with no markup.

records.name: Alongside
records.tagline: Learn to work better with AI, inside your project
records.description: Alongside helps you learn better AI workflows while building in Codex or Claude Code. Get practical guidance on prompts, context and debugging, understand why another approach may help, and save useful lessons privately in your project. Learn through the work you’re already doing.

records.name: Home
records.tagline: We opened a new store recently
records.description: is a trusted provider of advanced smart classroom and office technology solutions. We specialize in supplying and integrating interactive display panels from leading brands such as Teachmint and ViewSonic, along with reliable multifunction printers from Kyocera and Konica Minolta.

records.name: Marginalia
records.tagline: A personalized, agentic margin for the web
records.description: Marginalia turns the margin of any web page into a working notebook with an agent in it. Select a passage and write your note first. Then a Codex agent on GPT-6 Astra does work on that passage: it builds a small model you can adjust, checks what supports a claim, defines a term, or works an example. Each reply stays pinned to the exact words, beneath your note. Park threads for later. Everything joins a local, searchable library with source links and export. You approve what leaves your machine.

records.name: Feature Toggle
records.tagline: Launch features without deploys
records.description: Control what ships to users from the dashboard. Flip features live without waiting on a release. Free to try, Solo when you deploy.

records.name: HUI
records.tagline: A native, local-first Markdown editor. No WebView.
records.description: A calm space for Markdown, built with Rust and Slint instead of a WebView. Edit source, use a synchronized split preview, or focus on reading. Includes nine interface languages, syntax highlighting, local images, math, Mermaid diagrams, themes and adjustable typography. Free and open source, with macOS, Windows and Linux downloads. Version 0.2.0 is a development preview; live editing and rendering compatibility are still evolving.

records.name: Photographer
records.tagline: Sharing an interesting link I discovered today
records.description: Sharing an interesting link I discovered today. Take a look and decide for yourself. https://surli.cc/eohdwv

records.tagline: Know your parents are okay, without tracking them
records.description: Family Ping is a consent-based family safety app. One family member shares their latest known status with one trusted helper. Free, with no ads and no tracking.

records.name: A11yGate
records.tagline: Prove VoiceOver users can finish critical iOS workflows
records.description: A11yGate is an open-source Swift developer tool for testing whether VoiceOver users can actually complete important iOS workflows. It executes tasks, preserves machine-readable evidence, independently checks outcomes, and can use GPT-6 Astra for bounded planning and diagnosis.

records.name: Training Grounds
records.tagline: Motion guides for AI game character animation
records.description: I wanted to make a game. Getting a character to walk became a whole side quest. Training Grounds lets you preview 3D motion, export eight-frame sprite guides, and copy a prompt for your image generator. Walking, breathing, four directions, and local animated GLB import. Free and open source.

records.name: Clayrune
records.tagline: Build with AI. Stay in control.
records.description: Clayrune is mission control for your AI agents. Dispatch, monitor, and manage them all from one place, across all projects. Open-source, runs on your machine, works from your browser or phone, uses your own agents. MIT-licensed.

records.name: Nezographe
records.tagline: Explore perfume through notes
records.description: Explore perfume through a photographic landscape of notes. Approach tactile materials, discover five perfumes, and follow their published connections.

records.name: AURA AI Arcade
records.tagline: Mind-bending AI personality, aura & 10-year future predictor
records.description: Discover who you really are, predict your relationship aura, read your 10-year future letter, and test your instincts with AI. AURA AI is a futuristic mind-bending arcade powered by RRR PRO MEX. Experience 4 interactive modes: AI Character Reveal, Relationship Aura Compatibility, Letter from Future You (2036), and Rapid Choice Speed Rounds.

records.name: mazemaze
records.tagline: Mix a new language into the pages you already read
records.description: Try it before you install. The site now runs a live web preview: move one slider and watch the page you are reading mix into the language you are learning. mazemaze blends 10-80% of the sentences on the sites you already read into your target language. Click any mixed sentence to see the original. Translation runs on-device with Chrome's built-in AI, so the pages you read stay on your machine. Free. Gemini/OpenAI keys are optional, never required.

records.name: MarketSync
records.tagline: Copy Telegram signals to MT4, MT5, cTrader & more.
records.description: MarketSync is a cloud-based trading automation platfrm that copies Telegram signals automatically to MT4 MT5, cTrader, TradeLocker, Match-Trader and other spported trading platforms, with built-in risk contros and no VPS required.

records.name: Tonerune is live! Free guitar lessons.
records.tagline: Free guitar resources, music theory guides, lessons.
records.description: We're building a personal resource that helps you. Without ads, fluff, or distractions. We want our platform free, open, and helpful. We are building more than a website or an app- we are building something that makes you think and reflect on what tethers you to music, and we are sharing what we find meaningful. We don't have AI features that will talk to you and make you feel good because we want you to pick up your guitar, not your phone. We want you curious.

records.name: Fleck — Notes that organize themselves
records.tagline: Think freely. Fleck keeps it organized.
records.description: Native, local-first macOS notes with on-device dictation and permissioned local agent access. Source developer preview. - exterminatorrat/Fleck

records.name: Pragmys
records.tagline: Crack your developer dream job, with proof
records.description: Pragmys is an AI Powered Developer analytics platform for growth & career. It turns your code into proof of what you can build. It analyzes your real repositories to create evidence-based skill profiles, then matches those demonstrated capabilities against the jobs you want. Instead of relying on resumes or coding puzzles, developers can understand how well a role fits their actual experience before applying and grow to crack their dream jobs.

records.name: MintLink
records.tagline: Consise
records.description: Creative and strategy-driven Graphic Designer and Social Media Manager with over 5 years of experience driving brand growth. Holding an M.S. in Marketing…

records.tagline: Research-grade surveys without the four-figure contract
records.description: Surveys with the quality controls researchers pay Qualtrics for attention checks, quotas, randomization, panel integrations, per-question timing at an indie price. 100 free responses/mo, no respondent logins, AI drafting, live results. $15 for 10,000.

records.name: SEION backoffice with AI
records.tagline: Seion creates AI agents to make a business more efficient.
records.description: SEION creates AI agents connected to your entire company They are not isolated chatbots: they connect to your ERP, your CRM, and your channels to consult data and perform real tasks. Create as many agents as you need, by department and by language.

Here, you can combine scientific illustrations with editable shapes, labels and connectors, and export as formats such as SVG, PNG, PDF, PPTX and more. The app currently comes with a set of ~1000 biomedical SVG assets (detailed & simplified illustration modes) following a coherent design theme, all created with GPT-6 Astra.

records.name: Open Chord: Learn Guitar
records.tagline: Learn guitar
records.description: A guitar learning app, a guitar tuner, a metronome, and your guitar companion.

records.name: Shatterhold
records.tagline: Build a fortress or hunt your friends in this free voxel RTS

records.name: RankDots Opportunities
records.tagline: Turn Google Search Console data into clear next steps
records.description: RankDots Opportunities analyzes your Google Search Console data to find missing content, underperforming pages, quick wins, and structural issues. Every opportunity comes with a recommended action, so you know what to create, expand, split, or improve first.

records.name: 3DOME Taipei
records.tagline: Preview the most popular Dome in Taiwan in 3D before you go
records.description: Enter your seat or scan your ticket to explore a simulated view of Taipei Dome. Switch between baseball and concert layouts, compare viewpoints, and enjoy a playable stadium experience. Completely built with GPT-6 Astra in Codex within less than 24 hours.

With this app, you are more environment friendly, modern and as private individual you want yourself to be.

records.name: Cangjie · 仓颉

records.description: Explore the fascinating world of Chinese characters through illustrations, sourced historical forms and interactive visual journeys. Learn meanings, modern pinyin, and traditional and simplified forms.

records.name: KINBOUND
records.tagline: A tactical card adventure with evolving spirits
records.description: Build a team of three spirits and explore an 18-stage campaign across three chapters. Collect 30 companions with 90 forms, choose branching evolutions, and plan around revealed enemy moves. Play tactic cards, manage energy, and switch your front line. Free to play in your browser, with English and Chinese, local autosaves, and invite-link battles with a friend.

records.name: HORS
records.tagline: Human-origin resource sharing
records.description: CORS for AI agents. A browser asks which origin is this request from?; HORS asks which human is behind the agent making this call? — and answers with an anonymous, unforgeable World ID identity, so an MCP server or HTTP API can say "only my own human", "any verified human", or anything in between, without accounts, API keys or shared secrets.

records.name: Regexcellent
records.tagline: Learn regular expressions by writing them
records.description: An interactive regex course, a live playground, and short challenges. Learn a pattern, try it yourself, and see why it works.

records.name: GG Play Now

records.name: kromatik
records.tagline: Open beta: an AI agent that runs Blender, ComfyUI & VS Code
records.description: ⚠️ OPEN BETA — please read: features are added and removed weekly, the prices shown are placeholders and NOT final, card payments are not switched on yet, and there is no SLA. Agentic AI instances of Blender, VS Code, FreeCAD and ComfyUI. Describe the scene, app or render you want — the agent opens the real application on a real GPU and builds it autonomously, streamed live to your browser. Metered compute hours, zero local setup, 1 free GPU hour a month with no card.

records.name: ChangelogForge

records.name: Wrought
records.tagline: Build your world and play what happens next
records.description: Create a world through conversation, shape its characters and rules, and step into the story. Wrought turns your choices into lasting consequences, with character sheets and a shared play history. Play solo or invite others into your world.

records.name: MyToolKit
records.tagline: A collection of fast, AI-assisted web tools for daily tasks.
records.description: "Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I built MyToolKit (Next.js + Tailwind) to make everyday digital tasks fast and simple. Check it out and let me know your feedback! 🚀"

records.name: GoVoyage Travel 2.0
records.tagline: Your AI travel planner for trips made just for you
records.description: Stop spending hours researching your next trip. GoVoyageTravel uses AI to turn your destination, travel style, budget, interests, and trip length into a personalized itinerary. Get day-by-day plans, places to visit, activities, hotel suggestions, real photos, interactive maps, directions, and travel details—all organized in one place. Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway, a family vacation, or a multi-city adventure, GoVoyageTravel helps you spend less time planning and more time exploring.

records.name: FirstClickTools
records.tagline: Simple, fast, and free web tools for everyday utility
records.description: FirstClickTools is a collection of fast, free, and accessible online utilities designed to streamline your daily workflow without clutter, sign-ups, or ads getting in your way.

records.description: Noize is an on-device music practice app that separates songs into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and other stems. Stem separation runs locally on iPhone, so your music stays on your device.

records.tagline: Search, tweak & drag sounds from massive local libraries
records.description: Quickly search, preview and modify sounds across massive local libraries. Drag original files into Unity, Unreal, Godot, video editors or DAWs, or export modified sounds as separate WAVs. Free, portable and offline for Windows; source files remain untouched.

records.name: PhoneCheckr

records.description: moli: 40MB headless browser for AI agents. Lite, Fast, High-Compatibility. Built in Rust

records.description: Free browser practice studio that hears you play — vocal pitch training, vocal range tests, karaoke with live scoring, and guitar, piano and drum rooms that show every note you hit.

records.tagline: The video editor that rewrites itself around your work
records.description: Powermove is an iterative video editor that rewrites itself around your work. Ask an agent to add or fork panels, effects, and workflows, then load them into the running app. If it is wrong, steer it and try again. Every change can be undone.

Vote on dinners, score meals to your household tastes, plan the week, and let Bite Bot fix the 'what's for dinner' brain fart. We've taken meal times and made it a team sport, so everyone gets their say.

records.name: WriteXDM  Personalized X DMs
records.tagline: Personalized X DMs in 10 seconds
records.description: Paste any X handle. We read their real recent posts and write 2 personalized cold DMs in 10 seconds. Built for founders, freelancers, creators, and salespeople.

records.name: pdf2md
records.tagline: Convert PDF to Markdown right in your browser
records.description: PDF to MD converter that runs in your browser: convert PDF to Markdown with tables and heading levels intact. No upload, no sign-up, up to 1,000 pages a file.

records.name: Casian
records.tagline: AI-powered collaborative workspace for VC teams
records.description: Casian brings documents, due diligence, questions and investment memos into one collaborative workspace for VC teams. AI works with your fund's thesis and criteria, challenges claims, researches gaps and cites sources. New documents and call transcripts trigger analysis updates and feed the memo. Your team can comment, assign tasks and ask AI to investigate further, while keeping investment decisions in human hands. Now welcoming our first pilot funds.

records.name: Cortex
records.tagline: Earn your scrolling. Change the rules by voice.
records.description: Do a few push-ups, hold a plank or go for a walk. Earn time in your browsers and X. Cortex lets you tune activities, rewards and limits by voice or text. Tell it what to change, review it, approve it. A small Android experiment in using your phone on purpose.

records.name: T1 Arc
records.tagline: Your diabetes. The whole picture.
records.description: Glucose, insulin, food and health. T1 Arc brings your records together on Android, with optional Tarv1s answers and Wear OS support.

records.name: Product Graveyard
records.tagline: A cemetery for products that are no longer with us.
records.description: Product Graveyard is a digital cemetery for products that are no longer with us. Explore discontinued startups and apps, discover what they built, why they died, and the lessons their journeys left behind. Founders can bury their own products and preserve their story, turning failed products into lessons for the builders who come next.

records.name: WhyLab
records.tagline: Find why your ML model fails, prove it, repair it
records.description: WhyLab is an AI incident investigator built on GPT-6 Astra. Upload your model's predictions and Astra hunts for the root cause — ranking hypotheses, running falsification experiments on held-out data, and proposing a fix it then re-tests. No guesses presented as facts.

records.name: JigBench
records.tagline: Your workbench for reusable AI prompts
records.description: JigBench is a local-first prompt workbench for people using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI tool. Choose from 10 focused commands, combine compatible steps, add your material, and inspect the full prompt before copying it into your preferred AI tool. No account or API key required. No AI model runs inside JigBench. Saved workflows keep command choices and order locally in your browser, without saving your material.

records.name: Synerv
records.tagline: Automate less important work. Ship more.
records.description: Synerv helps businesses modernize legacy systems, migrate to the cloud, and integrate practical AI. Strategy, implementation, and support in one partnership.

records.name: Monogram
records.tagline: Lifetime Free email on your own domain
records.description: Connect your domain and start sending and receiving email in minutes for free for lifetime. Hate other email interfaces ? Don't worry you can use the same Gmail interface that you use or switch to ShadCN themed interface.

records.name: motive.md
records.tagline: BOINC + Kickstarter for shared agentic research
records.description: If OpenAI can solve a millennium prize problem with 30,000 agents, then why can't anyone contribute by crowdsourcing? Using the motive.md skill, agents follow a decentralized scientific method harness. Every contributor can pick up where the last one stopped. Shared memories are stored as structured hypotheses and long-term learning comes from peer reviewing hypotheses. The big picture: A conceptual UBI-in-tokens platform.

records.name: Matchaboy — Good games. Greener days.
records.tagline: Play handheld games. Discover what makes them tick.
records.description: Matchaboy turns handheld gaming into hands-on discovery. Play Game Boy and Game Boy Advance games, then pause and explore CPU instructions, memory, graphics and sound through a built-in Inspector. Free and open source, with two included indie games and direct host/join netplay. Built with Astra in Codex: an original Game Boy engine, mGBA-powered GBA support, and ten original game experiments available in the source.

records.name: StoreTwin
records.tagline: See your Shopify store through your customers' eyes
records.description: StoreTwin turns any Shopify storefront into a living visual map. Watch customer journeys unfold, let GPT-6 Astra investigate friction, and preview a better path before changing production.

records.name: PresentCast
records.tagline: Cast PDF, Images and Videos to Smart TV
records.description: PresentCast turns multiple PDFs, photos, and videos into reusable presentation playlists you can prepare, rehearse, and present from your iPhone or iPad. and support Cast to Smart TV. Plan the order before the session, keep the current and next content visible in Presenter View, follow elapsed time, and control the presentation without rebuilding a queue for every meeting, lesson, pitch, or event.

records.name: HOZPE
records.tagline: Restaurant recommendations from people who share your taste
records.description: Their stars may not be your stars. HOZPE compares your restaurant preferences with other diners to help you discover places through people who share your taste. Join our free beta, build your taste profile, and help shape what comes next.

records.name: Uplifty
records.tagline: Where Uplifting Begins
records.description: Uplifty is a mental wellness app for anyone navigating stress, grief, heartbreak, or addiction. Four things in one app: 💜 Support Groups - free, anonymous, 24/7, professionally moderated 🩺 1:1 Care - 100+ licensed therapists, filter by price & specialty 💬 Topics - open conversations around shared experiences 📝 Journaling - private space with CBT-based prompts Support groups are free. Therapy is affordable. Android & iOS.

records.name: Stick Fighter
records.tagline: A game reminiscent of the early 00s xiao xiao
records.description: Stick Fighter is a game built using GPT-6 Astra. It's inspired by the early 00s stick fighting flash animations like Xiao Xiao. Single and multiplayer.

records.name: ClipForge
records.tagline: Turn long videos into viral-ready clips with AI
records.description: ClipForge turns long-form videos into short-form content ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Upload a video and let AI analyze the content, find engaging moments, generate clips, create word-level captions, and automatically reframe videos for vertical and square formats. Instead of spending hours manually searching, cutting, captioning, and formatting, ClipForge handles the repetitive work so creators can focus on publishing.

records.name: Uber & Lyft Driver Earning Calculator
records.tagline: Real net hourly pay for Uber & Lyft drivers
records.description: Drivearn shows your real hourly pay as an Uber or Lyft driver — not the gross number your app shows. Enter your hours, distance, and weekly earnings, and it subtracts fuel, platform commission, and vehicle wear-and-tear to reveal your true net hourly rate. Works for both Uber and Lyft across the US, Canada, UK, Australia, and New Zealand. No sign-up needed — just your numbers and the real answer.

records.name: Attar
records.tagline: Desktop web apps without a browser inside
records.description: Attar is a native compiler for web apps. It compiles JavaScript and TypeScript ahead of time into machine code, with Blink handling rendering. Our early SDK already works with React, Tailwind CSS and selected shadcn/ui components. More frameworks are coming. Explore what compiles today, and use our published agent skill to help build your first native app.

records.name: Home Market View
records.tagline: Home Value data and historical trends by city & zip code
records.description: Explore home values, listings, sale prices, and rents across cities and ZIP codes across the USA

records.name: Horology Studio: Watch & Alarm
records.tagline: Craft a mechanical watch for your Home Screen
records.description: Horology Studio brings the feel of mechanical watches to your iPhone. Explore original timepieces, customize the dial, case, hands, strap, movement and more, then bring your creation to your Home Screen as a live analog widget. Wind the crown, inspect the movement, set alarms, and make keeping time feel a little more personal.

records.name: Muxel Mission Engineer
records.tagline: Investigate spacecraft anomalies. Test plans before action.
records.description: Mission Engineer is Muxel's first step toward a Space Agentic OS: a 3D sandbox for synthetic spacecraft anomalies. GPT-6 Astra explains evidence, while deterministic tools compare plans. The system can export review packages, but human review is strictly required, as there is no live spacecraft control.

records.name: Crossword Generator
records.tagline: Create crosswords from your own words and clues.
records.description: Crossword Generator lets you create a crossword from your own words and clues without building the grid manually. After generating it, you can customize the title, date, and layout, then add a theme, stickers, or a border. The finished crossword can be printed or saved as a PDF. This combines puzzle creation and customization in one tool.

records.name: Aura — Confidential Creator Fund
records.tagline: Fund creators without exposing your wallet history.
records.description: Privacy-first creator funding on Solana. Support creators without exposing your identity or financial history on-chain.

records.name: WandelBar
records.tagline: Customize the wallpaper area behind your Mac menu bar
records.description: WandelBar is a free, open-source macOS utility that customizes the wallpaper behind the system menu bar without replacing or overlaying it. Add blur, tint, gradients, textures, shadows and presets, use different styles per Space, and discover community-made presets in the online gallery.

records.name: Nanomouse
records.tagline: A privacy-protecting input method for faster typing
records.description: A new input method born for AI

records.name: Bindery
records.tagline: Bindery combines your Markdowns into Word, PDF, EPUB, KEPUB
records.description: Markdown is lovely to write in and awkward to hand over. It is the best way to write something long. Then you finish, and the person waiting wants Word, or a PDF, or something their e‑reader will open - and there you are, pasting an unpublished manuscript into a website you have never heard of. That's where Bindery is. Point it at a file or a folder, choose a format, and out comes the document - contents page that navigates, diagrams drawn, equations typeset, code still coloured.

records.name: Notion Goldmine
records.tagline: Find Profitable Notion Product Ideas Before You Build
records.description: Stop guessing what Notion product to build. Notion Goldmine is a practical research and validation system for creators and sellers. Learn to find promising niches, research the Notion Marketplace, analyze competitors, mine reviews and feedback, identify gaps, evaluate demand and competition, score ideas, and validate before building. Includes research frameworks, competitor analysis, review mining, scorecards, checklists, and worksheets. Research smarter. Validate earlier. Build with a reason.

records.name: foolscap
records.tagline: Delegate to your coding agents, and prove what came back
records.description: Tell foolscap what needs doing. GPT-6 Astra plans the work and routes it to Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode running on your machine. Then foolscap reads the test output and the diffs itself, so a result is evidence, not the agent's word for it. Red tests trigger a bounded repair; passing work gets reviewed by a different agent. Local-first, bring your own key, MIT.

records.name: Wingmate
records.tagline: Field Sales CRM & Pipeline Management | Wingmate
records.description: Wingmate is a sales CRM with pipeline management for small businesses, B2B sales, and service business teams. AI-powered sales pipeline and client tracking.

records.name: CRM Health Doctor — Agent Readiness
records.tagline: Know what your CRM evidence actually justifies automating
records.description: CRM Health Doctor combines deterministic CRM health checks with GPT-6 Astra to assess what AI agents can safely rely on. It distinguishes what is viable, conditional, unsupported, or still unknown — while keeping every conclusion tied to supplied evidence and human review in control.

records.name: AstraTune
records.tagline: AstraTune is a vocal studio and AutoTune in your browser
records.description: AstraTune is a vocal studio and AutoTune in your browser: live microphone tuning, stereo harmonies, expressive effects and note editing. From singing to rap, from a spoken phrase to a melody, explore your sound without losing the original recording.

records.name: Pickerway
records.tagline: Pickerway is a provably fair social media giveaway
records.description: Pickerway is a provably fair social media giveaway picker for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Collect comments, filter eligible entries, pick random winners, and publish shareable results anyone can verify.

records.name: Mingle
records.tagline: Find people through your agent
records.description: Mingle is an open-source network where AI agents help their people find each other. Tell your agent who you want to meet, approve the exact card it publishes, and let other agents find relevant people. No profiles to browse, no feed, and no ranking people. Introductions are double opt-in, and contact details are released only after both sides choose to share. Works with Claude, Cursor, OpenClaw, and any MCP client.

records.name: cMe
records.tagline: Live location sharing for families and groups
records.description: cMe is a privacy-focused location sharing app for families, friends, trips, events, and outdoor groups. Share live GPS locations, view location history, and manage groups across iPhone, Android, and the web. Motion-aware location technology minimizes GPS use when you’re not moving, while on-demand data syncing reduces unnecessary network traffic—helping save both battery and mobile data.

records.name: Astra Impact
records.tagline: Gpt 6 Astra inspired game!
records.description: Astra themed meta game built for the Astra launch event!

records.name: Square Footage Calculator
records.tagline: From room measurements to whole-box flooring plans
records.description: A free browser tool for DIY room measurement and flooring purchases. Enter feet and inches or metric, combine rooms, and add or subtract sections. Carry the total into a flooring plan that separates waste, whole-box rounding, spare boxes and optional costs. Copy or print the result without an account. Measurements stay in the tab; copy or print before refreshing.

records.name: Alternaut
records.tagline: Better software, without hours of research
records.description: Millions of people still use software that’s outdated, overpriced, bloated with ads, or simply no longer the best option. Great apps already exist. We help you find them. We scan the applications on your device and find the best alternatives for your needs. Every recommendation is backed by research, so you free up time to actually use the better tools instead of endlessly searching for them. So, what are you waiting for? It's time to level up your software stack.

records.name: Infinomni
records.tagline: Turn drawings into 3D creations you can play with and print
records.description: Infinomni lets anyone bring their own characters to life. Play with them in your virtual room, and 3D print them into existence. From figures to mini-robots, Infinomni designs any forms for the physical world starting with consumer hardware. Infinomni makes it fun to build things.

records.name: InboxJoy
records.tagline: Stupidly Simple Cold Outreach
records.description: Connect unlimited domains and inboxes. InboxJoy rotates sending across them automatically and watches bounce rates — if an inbox starts bouncing, it stops sending from it before your domain gets burned. Connect Gmail or Outlook in one click. Upload a CSV. No dedicated domains, no DNS, no ops layer. Also works entirely from Claude/ChatGPT via MCP. $25/mo flat, unlimited access. 7-day free trial.

records.name: Liberty Laser Eye Center
records.tagline: Advanced Laser Vision Correction & Eye Care
records.description: Liberty Laser Eye Center offers advanced LASIK and vision correction services with expert care. Schedule your consultation today for clearer sight.

records.name: Living Memory Lobby
records.tagline: AI rooms anyone can open with one link
records.description: Living Memory Lobby is the web entrance to Living Memory. Explore public rooms, start one with Empty, Work, or Dorm, or enter with a room link. Talk with the built-in guide, or connect your own AI through MCP. One link is enough — people without an AI harness can still walk in. Each room holds shared context and memories; return by URL. Browser visits let you explore without changing the room.

records.name: Reduce Images Online
records.tagline: 100+ image tools that keep your images in your browser
records.description: Reduce Images Online is a complete image toolkit built around privacy-first, browser-based processing. Compress, resize, convert, edit, inspect, extract and optimize images with 100+ tools while keeping your images in the browser instead of sending them to a server. From exact file-size and dimension workflows to metadata and privacy tools, it’s built to give you the result you actually need.

records.name: Voyagea
records.tagline: Discover places, plan trips & complete real-world Quests
records.description: Voyagea makes exploring easier, whether you're discovering your own city or planning your next adventure. Find nearby places based on your location, time and weather, create AI-powered itineraries, and turn exploration into a real-world adventure with location-verified Quests. Discover, plan and actually go. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: goLoadout
records.tagline: Turn real gear into 3D loadouts your audience can explore
records.description: Turn gear photos or video frames into 3D assets, build your operator, and share remixable loadouts. Built for airsoft players and gaming streamers, with GPT-6 Astra reviewing captures and 3D results, plus Live mode for audience voting.

records.name: Service Bazzar
records.tagline: All Services - One Bazzar
records.description: Service Bazzar is a trusted local business listing platform that helps people discover verified businesses and professional services across India. We connect customers with reliable service providers while helping businesses grow their online presence, generate quality leads, and reach more local customers. Our mission is to make local business discovery simple, fast, and trustworthy for everyone.

records.name: ClaimAppeal AI
records.tagline: Turn health insurance claim denials into clear appeals
records.description: ClaimAppeal AI helps people turn confusing health insurance claim denials into structured appeal letters. Enter your claim and denial details, and AI helps organize the information into a clear, personalized appeal draft that you can review and customize before submitting. Generate formal, legal-precedent and clinical-evidence backed insurance appeal letters in under 2 minutes. Overturn health insurance denials with ERISA § 503 and ACA § 2719 citations.
